translations.text: Blessed is the man who has not gone to the counsel of the ungodly, has not stood in the way of sinners, and has not sat in the seat of the lawless;
but his will is in the law of the Lord, and on his law he meditates day and night.
He shall be like a tree planted beside the streams of waters, which yields its fruit in its season and whose leaf does not fall; and all that he does shall prosper for him.
Not so the ungodly, not so, but they are like the dust that the wind lifts from the face of the earth.
Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the counsel of the righteous;
for the Lord knows the way of the righteous, and the way of the ungodly shall perish.
Why have the nations raged, and why has the people plotted vain things?
The kings of the earth conspired, and the rulers gathered together against the Lord and against his anointed.
Let us burst their bonds and cast their yoke away from us.
He who dwells in the heavens shall laugh at them, and the Lord shall hold them in contempt.
Then he shall speak to them in his wrath, and in his anger he shall terrify them.
I have been set up as king by him upon Zion, his holy mountain,
to declare the commands of the Lord. The Lord said to me: You are my son, and today I have begotten you;
ask of me, and I will give you all the nations as your inheritance, and all the ends of the earth as your possession.
You shall shepherd them with a rod of iron, and you shall shatter them like potters' vessels.
Now, O kings, understand this, and be instructed, all you judges of the earth.
Serve the Lord with fear and sing praise to him with trembling.
Accept instruction, lest the Lord become angry and you perish from the right way, when his anger suddenly flares up. Blessed are all who hope in him.
Lord, why have my oppressors multiplied? And many have risen up against me.
Many say to my soul: There is no salvation for him from his God.
But you, Lord, are my helper, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
With my voice I cried out to the Lord, and he heard me from his holy mountain.
I lay down, I slept, and I awoke, for the Lord became my helper.
I shall not be afraid of the myriads of people, of all those who have surrounded me.
Arise, Lord, save me, my God, for you have struck down all who were hostile to me without cause; you have shattered the teeth of sinners.
Salvation belongs to the Lord, and your blessing is upon your people.
When I called, the God of my righteousness heard me. In my distress you gave me relief; have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
Sons of men, how long will you be hard-hearted? Why do you love vanity and seek falsehood?
Understand that the Lord has made his holy one wondrous; the Lord will hear me when I cry out to him.
In your anger do not sin; what your hearts say now, repent of upon your beds.
Offer the sacrifice of righteousness and hope in the Lord.
Many say, "Who will show us good?" The light of your face has appeared to us, Lord.
You have given joy to our hearts from the fruit; with their wheat, wine, and oil you have multiplied them.
In peace I will lie down upon it and fall asleep, for you alone, Lord, have settled me in hope.
Hear my words, Lord; understand my cry.
Attend to the voice of my prayer, my King and my God, for to you I pray, Lord.
At dawn you will hear my voice; at dawn I will stand before you and appear to you.
For you, God, are not one who desires lawlessness; the wicked shall not dwell with you,
nor shall the lawless stand before your eyes; you have hated all who work lawlessness.
You will destroy all who speak falsehood; the Lord abhors a bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
But I, by your great mercy, will enter your house; I will worship at your holy temple in fear of you.
Lord, lead me in your righteousness, and because of my enemies make your way straight before me.
For there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is [?] (the word appears garbled; perhaps "vain"); their flesh is an opened grave; with their tongues they deceive.
Judge them, God; let them fall by their own schemes. For the great number of their impieties, cast them away from you, for they have embittered you, Lord.
Let all who hope in you rejoice in you forever. Let them delight in you, and may you dwell among them. Let all who love your name boast in you.
For you have blessed the righteous one, Lord; for as with a weapon, you have crowned us with your favor.
Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger, nor instruct me in your wrath.
Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak; relieve me, Lord, for my bones have trembled.
My soul has trembled greatly; and you, Lord, how long?
Turn back, Lord, deliver my soul, save me by your mercy,
For there is no one in death who remembers you, and who in hell will confess you?
I have grown weary with my sighing; every night I wash my bed, and I drench my couch with my tears.
My eye has been troubled by anger; I have worn away among all my enemies.
Depart from me, all you workers of lawlessness, for the Lord has heard the sound of my weeping;
and the Lord has heard the sound of my prayer; the Lord has accepted my worship.
Let all my enemies be ashamed and tremble; let them turn back and be greatly ashamed, and quickly.
O Lord my God, in you I trust; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers.
Lest he snatch away my soul like a lion, with no one to be my deliverer or savior.
O Lord my God, if I have done this, if there is lawlessness in my hands,
or if I have repaid with evil those who repaid me with evil, then let me indeed fall away empty before my enemies;
let the enemy pursue my soul and overtake it, let him trample my life on the earth and make my glory dwell in the dust.
Arise, O Lord, be exalted in your wrath to destroy all my enemies; awake, O Lord my God, by the command that you gave us,
and the assembly of the people will surround you; for this reason return on high, O Lord.
The Lord will judge his people. Judge me, O Lord, according to your righteousness and your blamelessness toward me.
Let evils come to an end upon sinners, and guide the righteous one aright, O Lord, righteous God who examines heart and kidneys.
My help truly comes from God, who saves the upright of heart.
God is righteous, a judge, mighty, long-suffering, who does not send forth his wrath every day.
If you do not turn back, his sword is sharpened; he has drawn his bow and made it ready;
with it he has made ready the vessels of death, and he has made his arrows burning.
Behold, he has been made powerless [?] by falsehood; he conceived pain and gave birth to lawlessness.
He dug a pit and hollowed it out, and he fell into the very trench he had made.
His pain has turned back upon his own head, and his falsehood has come down upon his own crown.
But I will confess the Lord and sing to the name of the Lord Most High.
O Lord, our Lord, how wondrous is your name in all the earth, for your beauty has been greatly exalted above the heavens.
By the mouth of infants and nursing babies let praise be established because of your enemies, so that the enemy and avenger might be destroyed.
For we have seen the heavens, the works of your hands, the moon and the stars, which you created;
what is man, that you remember him, or the son of man, that you look upon him?
You made him a little lower than your angels; you crowned him with glory and honor.
You set him over the work of your hands; you put all things in subjection under his feet,
sheep and oxen, all of them, and the beasts of the field as well,
the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, all that pass through the places of the seas.
O Lord, our Lord, how wonderful is your name in all the earth!
I will confess you, O Lord, with all my heart, and I will tell of all your wonders.
I will rejoice and be glad in you, and I will sing to your name, O Most High.
When all my enemies are turned back, they will grow weak and perish before your face,
for you have carried out your justice and my judgment; you sat upon thrones, O judge of righteousness.
You rebuked the nations, and the ungodly one perished; you blotted out their names forever and ever and ever.
The sword of the enemy has failed completely, and the cities were laid waste; their memory perished with a clamor;
but the Lord abides forever; he has prepared his throne for judgment.
He himself will judge the world in righteousness, and the people in uprightness.
The Lord became a refuge for the downtrodden, a helper in good time, in time of affliction.
Let all who know your name put their hope in you, for you have not forsaken those who seek you, O Lord.
Sing to the Lord, you who dwell in Zion; tell his deeds among the nations;
for he remembered to seek vengeance for their blood, and he did not forget the cry of the downtrodden.
Have mercy on me, O Lord, and see how I am humbled by my enemies, you who lift me up from the gates of death,
so that I may tell all your praises in the gates of the daughter of Zion; we will rejoice in your salvation.
The nations have sunk into the destruction they made; in the snare that they laid, their own foot was caught.
The Lord is made known by carrying out his judgment; the sinner was caught in the works of his own hands.
Let the sinners be turned back to hell, all the nations that have forgotten God.
For the poor will not be forgotten forever, and the endurance of the downtrodden will not perish completely.
Arise, O Lord. Let not men prevail; let the nations be judged before you.
Set, O Lord, a lawgiver over them; let the nations understand that they are men.
Why, O Lord, have you stood far off and disregarded me, just in the time of affliction?
In the arrogance of the ungodly the poor man is burned; let them be held back from their schemes which they have schemed.
For the sinner praises himself, and the ungodly man boasts in the desire of his own self.
The sinner has angered God; in the greatness of his anger he did not seek him out; God is not before his eyes.
His ways are defiled at all times; his judgments are removed from before his face, and he lords it over all his enemies.
For he said in his heart: I shall not be shaken from generation to generation, without evil.
His mouth is full of cursing and bitterness and deceit; under his tongue are toil and pain.
He sits in ambush with the rich, in secret, to kill the innocent; his eyes watch the poor.
He lies in ambush in secret, like a lion in its den. He lies in wait to snatch the poor man, to seize the poor man and drag him away.
With his snare he will bring him low; he will be brought low and fall when he lords it over the poor man.
For he said in his heart: God has forgotten it; he has turned away his face so as not to see at all.
Arise, O Lord my God, lift up your hand, and do not forget your poor utterly.
Why has the ungodly man angered God? Because he said in his heart: He will not look into this.
You will see it, the pain and the wrath; you observe, for they have been given into your hands. You protect the poor man, and you have been the helper of the orphan.
You break the arms of the arrogant and of the wicked man; his sin will be sought and will not be found.
The Lord is king forever and ever; the nations shall perish from his land.
You have heard the desire of the poor, O Lord; your ear has attended to the readiness of their heart,
to judge the orphan and the poor man, so that man may no longer again presume to speak richly upon the earth.
In the Lord I trust; how does one say to my soul: Should I be moving from place to place on the mountains like a sparrow?
For behold, the sinners have bent their bow [?]; they have readied arrows in their quivers, to shoot in the darkness, in secret, at the upright of heart.
What you have built, they have laid waste; but what has the righteous man done?
The Lord is in his holy temple; the Lord, his throne is in heaven. His eyes look upon the fallen, and his eyelids examine the sons of men.
The Lord will judge the righteous and the ungodly, and whoever loves sin hates his own self.
He will rain snares and fire upon sinners, brimstone and a stormy wind, for this is the portion of their cup.
For the Lord is righteous and he loves righteousness; the upright shall see his face.
Save me, O God, for the holy one has failed, for truths have dwindled away from among the sons of men.
A man spoke vanity to his neighbor; with deceitful lips, in his heart, with a double heart he spoke.
May the Lord destroy all deceitful lips and the tongue that speaks boastfully,
those who said: "Let us magnify our tongue; our lips are our own; and now who is lord over us?"
"Because of the distress of the poor and the sighing of the fallen, now I will arise," says the Lord; "I will establish my salvation and show myself openly upon them."
The words of the Lord are pure words, like silver refined by fire, choice, tested, purified from earth sevenfold.
You, O Lord, guard us, and keep us from this time forth and forever.
The ungodly walk all around; in your exaltation, be long-suffering toward all the sons of men.
How long, O Lord, will you forget us completely? How long will you turn your face away from us?
How long shall I lay up counsels in my soul and pain in my heart by day? How long shall my enemy be exalted over me?
Look upon me and hear me, O Lord my God; enlighten my eyes, lest I fall asleep in death,
lest my enemy ever say: "I have prevailed over him." Those who afflict me will rejoice if I am shaken.
But I trust in your mercy, O Lord; let my heart rejoice in your salvation; let me sing to the Lord, my benefactor, and praise the name of the Lord Most High.
The fool said in his heart: "There is no God." They have become corrupt and abominable in their lawlessness; there is no one who has done kindness.
The Lord looked down from heaven upon all the sons of men, to see whether there is anyone who understands, to seek out God.
All have turned aside together and become useless; there is no one who has done good, there is not even one.
All who work lawlessness did not understand, those who devour my people as one eats bread and did not call upon God.
There they were seized with fear where there was no fear, for God is among the generation of the righteous.
They did not put to shame the counsel of the poor, for the Lord is their hope.
Who will give salvation to Israel out of Zion? When the Lord brings back the captivity of his people, let Jacob rejoice and let Israel be glad.
O Lord, who shall dwell in your tent, or who shall settle on your holy mountain?
He who walks blamelessly and does righteousness, who speaks truth in his heart;
who does not deceive with his tongue, nor has done evil to his neighbor, and has not taken up a reproach against those near him.
Let the wicked be despised before him, but let those who fear the Lord be glorified; he who swore to his neighbor and did not lie to him;
he did not give his silver at interest, and he does not take a bribe against the innocent. Whoever does these things shall not be moved forever.
Keep [?] me, O God, for I trust in you.
I said to the Lord: You are my God; your goodness toward me is from you.
For your saints and those who are in your land, you have made all my will wonderful among them.
Their infirmities were multiplied, and after this they hastened; I will not gather their assemblies with blood, nor will I remember their names with my lips.
The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup; it is you who have given my inheritance to me.
The lot fell to me among the chosen, and my inheritance is firm for me.
I will bless the Lord, who gave me understanding, for even until night my kidneys have instructed me all the more.
I saw the Lord beforehand; he is before me always, for he is at my right hand, so that I may not be moved.
Therefore let my heart rejoice and let my tongue sing; moreover, my flesh too shall dwell in hope.
For you will not leave my soul in hell, nor shall my flesh see corruption.
Show me, O Lord, your ways of life, and fill us with the joy of your face, with the sweetness and beauty of your right hand, completely.
Hear, O Lord of righteousness, attend to my supplication, give ear to my prayer, for it is not from deceitful lips.
By your face may I be justified, and may my eyes see uprightness.
Test my heart, examine it by night; try me by fire, and let no lawlessness be found in me,
so that my mouth may not speak of the deeds of men; for the sake of the words of your lips I have kept to hard ways.
Make my feet firm in your places, so that my steps may not stumble.
I cried out to you, O Lord, for you have heard me, O God; incline your ear to me and hear my words.
Make your mercy wonderful, you who have saved those who trust in you from those who rise up against your right hand.
Keep me, O Lord, as the pupil of the eye, and in the shelter of your wings shelter me
from the face of the ungodly who oppressed me; my enemies have surrounded my soul
and have congealed in their fat; their mouth spoke arrogance.
They cast me out again; behold, they have turned and surrounded me. They set their heart on bringing me low to the ground.
They became to me like a lion prepared for prey, and like a lion's cub that sits lying in wait.
Arise, O Lord, go before them, bring them down, and deliver my soul from the ungodly.

The sword of your enemies is in your hand, O Lord my God; hold them back and diminish them from their land, scatter them, make them stumble in their life, for their belly was filled with secret things against you; they were sated with their food and left their remainder to their children.
But I, in my righteousness, shall appear before your face, and I shall be satisfied at the manifestation of your glory.
I will love you, O Lord, my strength,
O Lord, my establisher, my refuge, my helper and my deliverer; my God is my help, and I hope in him; my protector, the horn of my salvation, and the one who holds me by the hand.
With praise I called upon the Lord, and I escaped from my enemies.
The pains of death surrounded me, and torrents of lawlessness terrified me;
the afflictions of hell encompassed me, and the snares of death overtook me.
In my affliction I cried out to the Lord and prayed to my God; the Lord heard me from his holy temple, and my cry reached before him, to his ears.
The earth shook and trembled. The foundations of the mountains were shaken; it trembled, for God was angry with it.
Smoke went up in his anger, fire blazed out from his face, and sparks poured down from him.
He bowed the heavens and came down, with mist beneath his feet.
He mounted the cherubim and flew; he was lifted up on the wings of the winds.
He made darkness his covering, and around him was his dwelling: dark waters in the clouds of the air.
By his brightness before him the clouds carried off hail and sparks of fire.
The Lord thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave forth his voice.
He sent out his arrows and scattered them; he multiplied lightnings and terrified them.
The springs of the waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were revealed by your severity, O Lord, and by the wind, the breath of your anger.
He sent from on high, had mercy on me, and received me out of many waters.
He delivered me from my mighty enemies and from those who hate me, for they had grown stronger than I.
They overtook me on the day of my affliction, and the Lord became my strengthener.
And he brought me out into a broad place; the Lord delivered me, because he wanted me.
The Lord repaid me according to my righteousness, and according to the purity of my hands he will repay me.
For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and I have not acted impiously against my God;
for all his judgments are before me always, and I have not put his righteous decrees away from me.
I will be blameless with him, and I will keep myself from my iniquity.
The Lord will repay me according to my righteousness and according to the purity of my hands before his eyes.
With the holy I will be holy, and with the blameless man I will be blameless.
With the chosen I will be chosen, but the crooked you have overthrown.
For you saved a lowly people, O Lord, and you humbled the eyes of the proud.
For you lit my lamp, O Lord my God; you enlightened my darkness.
For through you I was delivered from trial, and through my God I crossed over the wall.
My God, your ways are blameless and the words of the Lord are choice; he is a refuge for all who hope in him.
For there is no God apart from the Lord, and there is no other God except our God.
God, who clothed me with strength and made my goings blameless,
made my feet firm like those of deer and set me on a high place,
trained my hands for combat and made my arms like a strong bow.
You gave me the help of your salvation, and your right hand will uphold me; your teaching has raised me up completely, and your instruction has taught me.
You made my steps wide beneath my feet, so that my footing would not weaken.
I will pursue my enemies and overtake them, and I will not turn back from them until I have finished them off.
I will press them hard and they will not be able to stand; they will fall beneath my feet.
You girded me with strength for battle against them; those who have risen up against me you put beneath me.
You put my enemies to flight and destroyed those who hate me.
They cried out and there was no one to deliver them; they called to the Lord and he did not hear them.
I will grind them fine like dust before the wind, and I will trample them like the mud of the streets.
You delivered me from the assault of the people; you set me as ruler over the nations; a people whom I did not know served me.
And with the obedience of the ear they heard me; foreign sons lied to me.
Foreign sons wasted away, grown old, and limped away from their places.
The Lord lives, blessed is God; the God of my salvation is exalted.
God, who seeks my vengeance, he has subjected the people beneath me,
my deliverer from my wrathful enemies; and above those who have risen up against me you have lifted me up; and from the wicked man you have delivered me.
Therefore I will confess you among the nations, O Lord, and I will sing praise to your name;
for he has made great the salvation of the king, showing mercy to his anointed, to David and to his descendants, for ever and for ever and ever.
The heavens tell the glory of God, and the firmament tells the created work of his hands.
Day announces the word to day, and night recounts knowledge to night.
There are no sayings, nor words of any, whose voice is not heard.
Their voice has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world.
In the sun he has set up his tent; and he himself, like a bridegroom coming out of his court, will rejoice like a hero to run the road.
His going out is from the edge of heaven, and his course reaches as far as its other edge; there is no one who can hide from his heat.
The law of the Lord is spotless and turns souls back; the testimonies of the Lord are trustworthy and make children wise.
The righteous decrees of the Lord are upright and gladden hearts; the commandments of the Lord are radiant and enlighten the eyes.
The fear of the Lord is holy and it endures for ever; the judgments of the Lord are in truth and are righteous altogether.
They are more desirable than gold and much precious carbuncle; they are sweeter than honey from the honeycomb.
For his servant too shall keep this, and in keeping it there is great reward.
Who can understand his own transgressions? Cleanse me from my secret ones,
and from the sins of strangers keep your servant; if they do not rule over me, then I shall be spotless and I shall be cleansed from great sin.
May the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart be pleasing to you, before you always, O Lord, my helper and my deliverer.
May the Lord hear you in the day of your affliction; may the name of the God of Jacob be your helper.
May he send you help from his holy place, and from Zion may he stretch out his hand to you;
may the Lord remember all your sacrifice, and may he be pleased with your vow.
May the Lord give you what is in your heart, and may he fulfill all your counsel.
We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of the Lord our God we shall be magnified. May the Lord fulfill your every request.
Now understand that the Lord has saved his anointed and has heard him from his holy heaven, for the salvation of his right hand is with might.
They with chariots and with horses, but we shall call upon the name of the Lord our God.
They stumbled and fell, but we rose up and stood upright.
Lord, save the king, and hear us on the day on which we call upon you.
Lord, in your strength the king shall rejoice, and in your salvation he shall delight greatly.
You have given him the desire of his heart, and you have not withheld from him the wish of his lips.
For you came to meet him with the blessing of your sweetness; you set on his head a crown of precious stone.
He asked life of you, and you gave him length of days forever and ever.
Great is his glory through your salvation; glory and great beauty you have laid upon him;
for you have given him blessing forever, and you have gladdened him with the joy of your face.
For the king trusts in the Lord, and through the mercy of the Most High he shall not be moved.
May your hand be found upon all your enemies, and may your right hand find all who hate you.
You shall make them like a furnace of fire at the time of your presence; the Lord in his wrath shall terrify them, and fire shall devour them.
He shall destroy their fruit from the earth and their offspring from among the sons of men.
For they turned evil against you; they devised a plan which they could not carry through.
For you have made them fugitives, and for your remnants he shall make ready their faces.
Be exalted, Lord, in your strength; we shall sing and give thanks to your might.
God, my God, look upon me; why do you forsake me? You have put me far from my life because of the words of my guilt.
My God, by day I cried out to you; you did not hear me by night, and you did not strive on my behalf.
But you dwell in the holy place, you, the praised one of Israel.
In you our fathers hoped; they hoped in you, and you delivered them.
To you they cried out and were saved; in you they hoped and were not put to shame.
But I am a worm and not a man, a reproach of men and despised by the people.
All who saw me scorned me; they spoke with their lips and shook their heads:
"He hoped in the Lord; let him deliver him, let him save him, for he delights in him."
You are the one who brought me out of the womb, my hope from my mother's belly;
upon you I was cast from the womb; from my mother's belly you are my God. Do not depart from me, for affliction is upon me.
And there is no one to help me.
Many young bulls surrounded me, and fat bulls encompassed me;
they opened their mouth against me, like a ravening and roaring lion.
But I was poured out like water, and all my bones were scattered; my heart became like wax melted in the midst of my belly;
my strength dried up like a potsherd, my tongue stuck to my palate, and they brought me down to the dust of death.
Many dogs surrounded me, and an assembly of the wicked encompassed me; they pierced my hands and my feet.
And they counted all my bones; they looked at me, they scrutinized me;
they divided my clothing among themselves, and over my tunic they cast lots.
But you, Lord, do not remove your mercy from me; Lord, look to my help;
deliver my soul from the sword, and my only-begotten state from the hands of the dogs;
save me from the mouth of the lion and from the horns of the unicorn, me in my lowliness.
I will tell your name to my brothers, and in the midst of a great assembly I will sing to you.
You who fear the Lord, praise the Lord, and all the race of Jacob, glorify him; let all the race of Israel fear the Lord.
For he did not despise or weary of the prayer of the poor man, nor did he turn his face away from me, and when I cried to him he heard me.
From you comes my praise in the great church; I will confess you, I will fulfill my vow before those who fear him.
Let the fallen eat and be satisfied, and let those who seek him praise the Lord; their hearts shall live for ever and ever.
Let all the ends of the earth remember and turn to the Lord; let all the tribes of the nations worship him;
for the kingdom is the Lord's, and he rules over all the nations.
Let all the fat ones of the earth eat and worship him; before him shall fall down all who go down to the earth; and my soul shall live through him.
And my descendants shall serve him; the Lord shall be made known to the generation to come.
And they shall tell of his righteous deeds to the people yet to be born, which the Lord has done.
The Lord shepherds me, and I shall lack nothing.
In a green place, there he shall settle me; by waters of rest, there he shall raise me.
Turn my soul back to me, and lead me in the paths of your righteousness for your name's sake, Lord.
Even if I walk among the shadows of death, I shall not fear evil, for you, Lord, are with me; your rod and your staff, these shall comfort me.
You have prepared a table before me, to the envy of my oppressors; you have anointed my head with oil, and your cup has made me drunk, as one who was parched.
May your mercy, O Lord, go along with us all the days of our life, so that we may dwell in the house of the Lord for length of days.
The earth is the Lord's, and its fullness, the world and all who dwell upon it.
For he himself founded them upon the sea, and prepared them upon the rivers.
Who shall go up the mountain of the Lord, or who shall stand in his holy place?
The one innocent of hands and pure of heart, who has not lifted up his soul to vanity, nor sworn deceitfully to his neighbor.
This one has received blessing from the Lord, and mercy from God his Savior.
This is the generation that seeks the Lord, that seeks to see the face of the God of Jacob.
Open your gates, O rulers; let the everlasting gates be opened, and the King of glory shall enter.
Who is this King of glory? The Lord, strong and firm, the Lord, mighty in battle.
Lift up your gates, O rulers; lift up the everlasting gates, and the King of glory shall enter.
Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he himself is the King of glory.
To you, O Lord, I have lifted up my soul.
My God, I trust in you; let me not be put to shame, nor let my enemies laugh at me.
Let none who wait patiently for you be put to shame; let those be ashamed who act lawlessly in vain.
Make your ways known to me, O Lord, and teach me your paths.
Guide me, O Lord, in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and I have waited patiently for you always.
Remember, O Lord, your mercies and your compassions, for they are from everlasting.
Do not remember the sins of my youth and of my ignorance, O Lord; in your mercy remember me, O Lord, for the sake of your sweetness.
For you are sweet and upright, O Lord. Therefore you have given sinners the law in the way.
Guide the meek in judgment; teach the meek your ways.
All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth for those who search out his covenants and his testimonies.
For the sake of your name, O Lord, be merciful to me for my sins, for they are many.
Who is the man who fears the Lord? He will give him the law in the way that he has been pleased to choose.
Their soul shall rest in good things, and his descendants shall inherit the land.
The Lord is strength to those who fear him, and he will make his law known to them.
My eyes are always toward the Lord, for he has delivered my feet from the snare.
Look upon me and have mercy on me, for I am an only child and poor.
For the afflictions of my heart have multiplied; bring me out of my sorrows.
See my lowliness and my toil, and forgive me all my sins.
See, for my enemies have multiplied, and they have hated me with hatred in vain.
Guard my soul and deliver me, and do not let me be put to shame, for I have called upon you.
The blameless and the upright have joined me, those who wait patiently for you, O Lord.
Redeem Israel, O God, from all its afflictions.
Judge me, O Lord, for I have walked in my blamelessness; I trust in the Lord, so that I may not grow weak.
Test me, O Lord, and examine me; try my heart and my kidneys.
For your mercy is always before my eyes, and I have been pleasing to your truth.
I did not sit in the seat of vanity, and I will not go in with the lawless.
I have hated the assembly of the wicked, and I will not stand with the ungodly.
I will wash my hands in purity and go around your altar, O Lord,
to hear the voice of your praise, O Lord, and to tell all your wonders.
O Lord, I have loved the beauty of your house and the place of the dwelling of your glory.
Do not destroy my soul with the ungodly, nor my life with men of blood,
whose hands are always in lawlessness, and whose right hand is full of bribes.
But I have walked in my blamelessness; deliver me, O Lord, and have mercy on me.
My feet have stood in uprightness; in the church I will bless you, O Lord.
The Lord is my light and my savior; of whom should I be afraid? The Lord is the refuge of my life; of whom should I tremble?
When the wicked drew near against me to devour my flesh, my oppressors and my enemies, they grew weak and fell.
If a people is arrayed against me, my heart will not fear; if battle rises against me, even then I trust in you.

One thing I have asked of the Lord, and this I will pray for: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, that I may see the beauty of the Lord and the possession of his temple.
For he hid me in his tent on the evil day, he sheltered me under the covering of his tent, he raised me high upon a rock.
Now behold, my head has been lifted up over my enemies; I went around his tent, I shall offer a sacrifice of praise, I shall bless the Lord and sing to him.
Hear, O Lord, the voice of my prayer with which I have cried out to you; have mercy on me and hear me.
To you my heart said: I seek your face, O Lord.
Do not turn your face away from me, and do not turn away in wrath from your servant. Be my helper; do not despise me and do not forsake me, O God, my Savior.
For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the Lord has received me.
Instruct me, O Lord, in your ways, and lead me in your straight places because of my enemies.
Do not give me into the hands of my oppressors, for false witnesses have risen up against me, and they lied in their lawlessness.
I believe that I shall see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.
Wait patiently for the Lord; let my heart be brave and be strengthened, and wait patiently for the Lord.
To you, O Lord, I have called; my God, do not be silent toward me, and do not keep silent concerning me, lest I become like those who go down into the pit.
Hear, O Lord, the voice of my prayer when I pray to you, when I lift up my hands toward your holy temple.
Do not count me with sinners, and do not ever destroy me with the doers of lawlessness, who speak peace to their neighbor while evil is in their heart.
Repay them according to their deeds, and according to the evil of their walk repay them; according to the work of their hands repay them their own recompense.
For they did not understand the works of God, nor did they look upon the making of his hands; tear them down, so that they may not be built up [?].
Blessed is the Lord, for the Lord has heard the voice of my prayer.
The Lord is my helper and my protector; in him my heart hoped, and he helped me; my flesh rejoiced, and willingly I shall give thanks to him.
The Lord is the strength of his people, and he is the refuge for the salvation of his anointed.
Save, O Lord, your people and bless your inheritance. Shepherd them and exalt them forever.
Offer to the Lord, you children of God, offer to the Lord the young of rams; offer to the Lord glory and honor.
Offer to the Lord glory to his holy name. Worship the Lord in his holy court.
The voice of the Lord is upon the waters; the God of glory thundered, the Lord upon many waters.
The voice of the Lord is upon the waters with might and with great splendor.
The voice of the Lord shatters the firs; the Lord shatters those firs of Lebanon.
He crushes them small like the young plants of Lebanon; and the beloved one is like the young of a unicorn.
The voice of the Lord cuts through the flame of fire.
The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness, and the Lord makes that wilderness of Kadesh tremble.
The voice of the Lord strengthens the deer and lays bare the high forests; in his temple all the people shall speak of his glory.
The Lord calms and stills the waters of the flood; the Lord shall sit as king forever.
The Lord will give strength to his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.
I will exalt you, O Lord, for you have taken me under your protection and have not let my enemy rejoice over me.
O Lord my God, I cried out to you, and you had mercy on me;
O Lord, you brought my soul up from hell and saved me from those who go down into the pit.
Sing to the Lord, you his worthy ones, and give thanks to the remembrance of his holiness.
For there is wrath in his anger, and there is life in his will; in the evening there will be weeping, and at dawn joy.
I said in my prosperity: I shall not be shaken forever.
O Lord, by your will you gave strength to my beauty; you turned your face away from me, and I was terrified.
To you, O Lord, I cried out, and to my God I prayed.
What profit is there in my blood, if I go down to corruption? Will the dust give you thanks, O Lord, or declare your truth?
The Lord heard me and helped me, and the Lord became my helper.
He turned my mourning into joy for me; he stripped me of sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
so that I may sing to you, O my glory, and may not regret it. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to you forever.
In you, O Lord, I trust; let me not be put to shame forever. In your righteousness save me and deliver me.
Incline your ear to me and hasten to deliver me; be a protecting God to me, a house of refuge for my salvation.
For you are my strength and my refuge; for your name's sake, O Lord, lead me and nourish me.
And bring me out of the snare that they have laid for me, for you are my protector, O Lord.
Into your hands I commit my spirit; save me, O Lord God of truth.
You have hated those who hold to the fear of vanity in vain; but I, O Lord, trust in you.
Let me sing to you and rejoice at daybreak in your mercy, for you have looked upon my lowliness and saved my soul from distress;
you did not give me into the hands of my enemies; you have set my feet in a broad place.
Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am in distress; my eye, my soul, and my belly are troubled with anger.
For my life has failed in pain and my years in sighing; my strength has weakened through poverty, and all my bones have trembled.
More than all my enemies I have become a great reproach to my brethren, and a dread to those who know me; those who see me flee away from me.
They have forgotten me from their hearts like one who is dead, and I have become like a ruined vessel.
For I have heard the reproach of many who were around me; when they gathered together against me, they plotted to take my soul.
But I have trusted in you, Lord; I said: You are my God.
And in your hands is my inheritance; deliver me from the hands of my enemies and of my pursuers.
Show your face upon your servant and save me by your mercy.
Lord, do not let me be put to shame, for I have called upon you; let the ungodly be put to shame and let them go down to hell.
Let the deceitful lips become mute, which speak lawlessness against the righteous with pride and contempt.
For you have made great the mercy of your sweetness, Lord, which you have stored up for those who fear you; you have fulfilled your promise to those who trust in you before the sons of men.
You will strengthen them with the shelter of your face against the agitation of men; you will hide them in your tent from the attack [?] of tongues.
Blessed is the Lord God, for he has made his mercy wonderful upon a strong city.
I said in my amazement: Have I indeed been cast away from before your eyes? Therefore you heard the voice of my prayer when I cried out to you.
Love the Lord, all his worthy ones, for the Lord seeks truth, and he will repay those who act exceedingly in pride.
Let your hearts be brave and firm, you who trust in the Lord.
Blessed are those whose lawless deeds have been forgiven and whose sins have been covered.
Blessed is the man to whom the Lord has not reckoned sin, and in whose soul there is no guile.
For I kept silent, and all my bones wasted away [?] through my crying out all day long.
For day and night your hand grew heavy upon me; I was turned to poverty, for a thorn pierced me.
I will make my sin known to you, and my lawlessness I will not hide from you; you said [?]: I will tell my guilt to the Lord, and you forgave me all the lawlessness of my sin.
Therefore let every holy one pray to you at the time of offering, but the destruction of many waters will not reach him.
You are my refuge from the affliction that surrounds me; my joy, deliver me from those who have encircled me.
I will make you wise and understanding in the way in which you were going; I will fix [?] my eyes upon you.
Do not be like a horse and a mule, which have no understanding; with bit and bridle their jaws are to be turned, those who have not drawn near to you.
Many are the scourges for sinners, but those who trust in the Lord, mercy surrounds them.
Rejoice in the Lord, you righteous; be glad and boast in him, all you upright of heart.
Rejoice in the Lord, you righteous; praise is becoming to the upright.
Give thanks to the Lord with blessing; sing to him with praise on the ten-stringed psaltery.
Praise the Lord with a new praise; sing well to him with blessing.
For the word of the Lord is upright, and all his works are done in faithfulness.
The Lord loves mercy and justice; the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.
By the word of the Lord the heavens were established, and by the spirit of his mouth all their power.
He gathers the waters of the sea as in wineskins; he places them in the treasuries of the abysses.
Let all the earth fear the Lord, and let all the inhabitants of the world tremble before him.
For he spoke and they came to be; he himself commanded and they were created.
The Lord scatters the counsel of the nations; the Lord brings to nothing the counsel of the people, and the Lord brings to nothing the counsels of the rulers.
But the counsel of the Lord stands forever, and the thought of his heart from generation to generation.
Blessed is the nation whose helper is the Lord God, the people whom he has chosen as his own inheritance.
From heaven the Lord looked down upon all the children of men.
From his prepared dwelling place the Lord looked down upon all the inhabitants of the world,
he who alone created their hearts, who understood all their thoughts.
A king is not saved by his many troops, nor a mighty man by his great strength.
A horse deceives [?] as a means of deliverance; by its great strength it cannot save its rider.
The eyes of the Lord are upon those who fear him, who hope in his mercies,
to deliver their souls from death and to nourish them in famine.
My soul waits patiently for the Lord, for he is my helper and protector;
for in him my heart shall rejoice, and in his holy name it shall hope.
Let your mercy, O Lord, be upon us, as we hope in you.
Let us bless the Lord at all times; his praise is ever in our mouth.
In the Lord let our soul be praised; let the meek hear and rejoice.
Let us magnify the Lord together, and let us exalt his name as one.
Let us seek out the Lord; he will hear us and deliver us from all our afflictions.
Come to the Lord, receive light, and your faces will not be ashamed.
This poor man cried out to the Lord; the Lord heard him and delivered him from all his afflictions.
The camp of the angels of the Lord surrounds those who fear him, and he will deliver them.
Taste and see that the Lord is sweet; blessed is the man who hopes in him.
Fear the Lord, all his saints, for those who fear him have no want.
The rich have become poor and have gone hungry, but those who hope in the Lord will not lack any good thing.
Come, children, listen to me, and I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
Who is the man who desires life and loves to see good days?
Restrain your tongue from evil, and let your lips not speak deceit;
turn away from evil, do good, seek peace and pursue it.
The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are upon their prayers;
the face of the Lord is upon those who do evil, to destroy the memory of them from the earth.
The righteous cried out to the Lord; the Lord heard them and delivered them from all their afflictions.
The Lord is near to those who are crushed in heart, and he will save those who are lowly in spirit.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous man, and from all of them the Lord will deliver him.
The Lord will guard all their bones, and not one of them will be broken.
Death is evil for sinners, and those who hate the righteous man will regret it.
The Lord will guard the souls of his saints, and none of those who hope in him will regret it.
Judge, O Lord, those who harm me, and fight against those who fight me;
take up arms and shield, and rise up as my helper;
take up your sword against my pursuers and stop them; say to my soul: I am your deliverer.
Let those who seek my soul be ashamed and disgraced; let those who plot evil against me be turned back and put to shame.
Let them become like dust before the wind, and let the angel of the Lord afflict them;
Let their ways be dark and slippery, and let the angel of the Lord pursue them.
For without cause they set for me a snare of their corruption, and in vain they reproached my soul.
Let a snare come upon them that they do not know; let the trap that they set catch their foot, and let them be entangled [?] in that very snare of theirs.
But my soul shall rejoice in the Lord and delight in his salvation.
Let all my bones say: Lord, Lord, who can be like you? For you deliver the poor from the hands of the mighty, the poor and fallen from those who plunder him.
For false witnesses rose up against me and questioned me about what I did not know;
they repaid me evil in place of good and plotted the bereavement of my soul.
But when they were afflicting me, I put on sackcloth, I humbled my soul with fasting, and my prayer returned to my own bosom.
As a brother and friend, so I was pleasing; as one mourning and grieving, so I was humbled.
They rejoiced over me and gathered; scourges gathered against me and I did not perceive it; they were scattered and did not repent.
They tested me and treated me with utter contempt; they gnashed their teeth at me.
And I cried out: Lord, when will you look upon me? Remove my soul from their evil deed, and my only-begotten self from the lions.
I will confess you, Lord, in the great church, and in the assembly of many I will praise you,
so that my enemies, who hated me without cause, may not rejoice over me; they winked with their eye.
They spoke peace with me, and yet in wrath they devised deceit.
They opened their mouth against me and said: Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen it.
See, Lord, do not be silent; Lord, do not go far from me.
Awake and attend to my judgment, my God and my Lord, to my cause.
Judge me according to your righteousness, Lord my God, so that my enemies may not rejoice over me.
Let them not say in their heart: Aha, aha, to our soul! Nor let them say: We have swallowed him up.
Let all who rejoiced at my misfortune be ashamed and confounded; let those who spoke grandly against me be clothed in shame and confusion.
Let all who desired my righteousness rejoice and delight in you. Let those who desire the peace of your servant say at all times: God is great.
My tongue shall speak of your righteousness, and of your praise every day.
The lawless one spoke in sin in his heart; there is no fear of God before his eyes;
for he acted deceitfully before him, to find out his own lawlessness and hatred.
The words of his mouth are lawlessness and deceit; he does not wish to understand what is good.
He devised lawlessness on his bed; he set himself on every wicked way, and evil was not loathsome to him.
O Lord, your mercy is in heaven, and your truth reaches to the clouds;
your righteous acts are like the mountains, O God, and your judgments are like many abysses. Man and beast you save, O Lord,
as you have multiplied your mercy, O God; and the sons of men will hope in the shelter of your wings.
They will be drunk with the fatness of your house, and you will give them to drink from the river of your delight.
For from you is the fountain of life, and in your light we have seen light.
Extend your mercy to those who know you, and your righteousness to the upright of heart.
Let not the foot of the proud come upon me, and let not the hand of the sinner shake me.
There all the workers of lawlessness have fallen; they have been cast out and will no longer be able to stand.
Do not be envious of the wicked, nor envy those who do lawlessness;
for like grass they will quickly wither, and like green herbs they will soon fall away.
Hope in the Lord and do kindness; dwell in the land, and you will be pastured on its riches.
Delight in the Lord, and he will give you the request of your heart.
Reveal your ways before the Lord and hope in him, for he will act;
he will make your righteousness shine forth like the light, and your judgment like the noonday.
Submit to the Lord and serve him, and do not envy those whose ways are prospered, along with the man who does lawlessness.
Cease from anger, abandon your wrath, and do not imitate the wicked.
For the wicked will soon be destroyed, but those who wait patiently for the Lord will inherit the land.
A little while, and the ungodly will be no more; you will look for his place and will not find it;
but the meek will inherit the land and will delight in abundant peace.
The sinner watches the righteous man and gnashes his teeth at him;
but the Lord laughs at him and foresees it, for his day is coming.
Sinners have drawn the sword and strung their bow, to cast down the poor and the helpless and to kill those who are upright of heart.
May their sword pierce their own heart, and may their bows be broken.
The little of the righteous is better than the great wealth of sinners.
For all the arms of sinners will be crushed, but the Lord will make the righteous firm.
The Lord knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will stand forever;
they will not be put to shame in an evil time, and in the day of famine they will be filled.
For behold, sinners will perish, and the enemies of the Lord, in the very moment of their glory and exaltation, will fail and vanish like smoke.
The sinner borrows and does not repay, but the righteous shows mercy and gives.
For those who bless him will inherit the earth, but those who curse him will be destroyed by him.
A man's walk is directed by the Lord, and he will take great delight in his way.
Even if the righteous stumbles, he will not fall, for the Lord holds him by the hand.
I was a child, and I have grown old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his offspring begging for bread.
Every day he shows mercy and lends, and his descendants will be blessed.
Turn away from evil, do good, and dwell [?] upon it forever and ever.
For the Lord loves justice and will not forsake his holy ones; he will keep them forever. But the lawless will be driven out together, and the descendants of the ungodly will be destroyed.
The righteous will inherit the earth and will settle upon it forever and ever.
The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
The law of his God is in his heart, and his steps will not stumble.
The sinner watches the righteous and seeks to kill him.
But the Lord will not abandon him into his hands, nor bring him to nothing when he judges him.
Wait patiently for the Lord and keep his ways; he will exalt you to inherit the land, and you will see the destruction of sinners.
I saw the ungodly exalted and raised higher than the firs of Lebanon.
I passed by, and at once the ungodly was no more; I searched for his place and did not find it.
Keep blamelessness and look upon uprightness, for there is a remnant for the peaceable man.
But the lawless will be driven out together, and the offspring of sinners will perish.
For the salvation of the righteous is from the Lord, and he is their protector in the time of distress.
The Lord will help them and deliver them; he will rescue them from sinners and save them, because they hoped in him.
Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger, nor discipline me in your wrath.
For your arrows have struck me, and you have made your hand firm upon me.
There is no healing for my flesh because of your wrath; there is no peace for my bones because of my sins.
For my iniquities have risen above my head, and like a heavy burden they have weighed heavily upon me.
My wounds have grown foul and have rotted because of my foolishness.
I have become wretched, I have been brought very low; all day long I went about grieving;
for my loins are filled with the marks of beating, and there is no healing for my flesh.
I have been afflicted, I have been brought very low, and I cried out with the groaning of my soul.
Lord, all my desire is before you, and my groaning has not been hidden from you.
My heart trembled within me, my strength has left me, and the light of my eyes, that too was no longer with me.
Those who love me and my friends drew near before me and stood, and those close to me stood far off from me.
They pressed me hard and sought my soul, and those who sought it spoke evil against me, and they plotted sin and deceit all day long.
But I, like a deaf man, did not hear, and was like a mute who does not open his mouth.
I became like a man who does not hear, in whose mouth there is no word.
But I, Lord, trust in you; and you, hear me, Lord my God.
I said: Let my enemies never rejoice over me; at the shaking of my feet they spoke boastfully against me.
For I am prepared for scourging, and my pains are before me always.
For I said: I will declare my lawlessness, and I was anxious over my sins.
Now behold, my enemies are alive and have grown stronger than I; those who hated me without cause have multiplied;
and those who repaid me evil for good slandered me, because I pursued righteousness.
Do not cast me away, Lord my God, nor withdraw from me;
look to my help, Lord God of my salvation.
I said: I will keep my ways, so that I may not sin with my tongue; I set a restraint [?] upon my mouth when the sinner came up against me.
I became deaf, I was humbled, I kept silent even from good things, and my pains were renewed.
My heart grew hot within my belly, and in my meditation a fire blazed up.
I spoke with my tongue and said: Make known to me, O Lord, my end, and the number of my days, how many they are, so that I may know what I still lack.
Behold, you have made my days by measure, and the firmness of my strength is as nothing before you; for in every way every man of flesh is vain.
Yet man walks about as an empty image; in vain they toil; they store up treasure and do not know who will gather it.
Now who is my endurance, if not you, the Lord? For you are the strength of my firmness.
From all my lawless deeds deliver me; you have given me over as a reproach to the foolish.
I became deaf and did not open my mouth, for it is you who have done it.
Remove my torments from me, for by the strength of your hand I have wasted away;
and for the reproof of iniquity you have disciplined man; you have made his soul melt away like a spider's web, for man is vain.
Hear my supplication, O Lord, and give ear to my prayer. Do not keep silent at my tears, for I am a stranger before you and a passer-by, like all our fathers.
Spare me, that I may find rest before I depart, and then I shall be found no more.
With patience I waited for the Lord; he looked upon me and heard my prayer.
He brought me up out of the pit of misery, out of the clay and mire; he set my feet firmly on a rock and directed my steps.
He filled my mouth with a new song; many saw the praise of my God, and they were afraid and hoped in the Lord.
Blessed is the man whose hope is the name of the Lord, who has not looked to vanity nor to the delusion of falsehood.
You have multiplied your wonders, O Lord my God, and in your counsel there is no one who can be likened to you; I declared and spoke, and they were multiplied beyond number.
Offering and sacrifice you did not desire, but you have established a body for me. Burnt offering for sins you did not ask.
Then you said: Behold, I come; at the head of the books it is written of me.
To do your will, my God, I have desired, and your law is in the midst of my belly.
I proclaimed the good news of your righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I did not restrain my lips. O Lord, you know:
I did not hide your righteousness in my heart; I spoke of your truth and your salvation; I did not hide your mercy and your truth in the great assembly.
But you, O Lord, do not remove your mercy from me; your mercy and your truth have always upheld me.
For evils have surrounded me, of which there was no number; my iniquities have overtaken me and I could not look up; they have multiplied more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has forsaken me.
Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me; O Lord, look to help me.
Let them be ashamed and confounded together who seek my soul to take it; let them be turned back and put to shame who devise evil against me.
Let those who say to me 'Aha, aha!' be clothed at once with shame and confusion.
Let all who seek you, O Lord, sing and rejoice in you. Let those who love your salvation say always: Great is God!
But I am poor and helpless; O God, strive on my behalf. You are my helper and my refuge, my God; do not delay.
Blessed is the one who has regard for the poor and helpless; on the evil day the Lord will deliver him.
May the Lord guard him and keep him alive and make him blessed on the earth, and may he not give him into the hands of his enemies.
May the Lord help him on his bed of pain; may he turn all his bedding away from his infirmity.
I said: Lord, have mercy on me, be gracious to my soul, for I have sinned against you.
My enemies spoke evil about me: When will he die, and his name perish?
If he comes in to see me, he speaks vanity; his heart has gathered lawlessness to itself; he goes outside and says the same.
All my enemies whispered about me and plotted evil against me.
They laid a lawless word upon me: The one who sleeps, will he not rise again?
For even this man, the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has magnified deceit against me.
But you, O Lord, have mercy on me, raise me up, and I will repay them.
By this I knew that I have pleased you: that my enemies do not rejoice over me.
And you received me in my innocence and established me before you forever.
Blessed is the Lord God of Israel from now on and forever! So be it, so be it!
As the deer longs for the springs of water, so my soul longs for you, O God.
My soul longs for you, O mighty and living God; when will I come and appear before the face of God?
My tears have become my food day and night, while they say to me every day: Where is that God of yours?

But I remembered this and comforted my soul: for I will pass through the place of the wondrous dwellings to the house of God, with the voice of singing and of thanksgiving, with the voice of festal celebration.
Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you make me tremble? Hope in God, for I will give thanks to him, the Savior of my face and my God.
My soul trembled within me; therefore I will remember you from the land of the Jordan and of Hermon, from the little mountain.
Deep called to deep with the voice of its cataracts; all your surges [?] and your waves have passed over me.
By day the Lord commanded his mercy, and by night his song; my prayer is to God my Savior.
I said to God: You are my helper; why do you forsake me, and why am I sorrowful through the affliction of the enemy?
In the crushing of my bones my enemies reproached me, while they say to me every day: Where is that God of yours?
Now why are you sorrowful, my soul, or why do you make me tremble? Hope in God, for I will give thanks to him, the Savior of my face and my God.
Judge me, O God, and judge my cause against an unholy race; deliver me from the false and crafty man.
For you, God, are my strength; why do you cast me away, or why am I sorrowful through the affliction of the enemy?
Send forth your light and your truth, so that these may guide me and bring me to your holy mountain and to your dwellings.
Let me go in before the altar of God, of God who gladdened my youth; I will give thanks to you with blessing, O God, my God.
Why are you sorrowful, my soul, or why do you make me tremble? Hope in God, for I will give thanks to him, the Savior of my face and my God.
O God, we have heard with our ears what our fathers told us: the work that you did in their days, in those former days.
Your hand destroyed the nations and settled them; you did evil to that people and drove them out.
For it was not by their sword that they inherited the land, nor did their arm save them, but your right hand and arm. And yours [?] and the light of your face, for you took pleasure in them.
You yourself are our King and our God, who commanded the salvation of Jacob.
Through you we shall strike down our enemies, and in your name we have treated with contempt those who have risen up against us.
For I do not trust in my bow, nor shall my sword save me.
But you saved us from our oppressors and put to shame those who hate us.
In God we shall boast every day, and we shall sing to his name forever.
But now you have removed us far away and put us to shame, and you did not go out, O God, as our strength.
You have turned us backward more than all our enemies, and those who hate us plundered us on every side.
You have given us up like sheep for food and scattered us among the nations.
You gave up your people without price, and there was no number [?] to our outcry.
You have made us a reproach to our brothers, a laughingstock and an object of scorn to those around us.
You have made us a byword among the nations and a shaking of the head among the people.
Every day my disgrace is continually before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,
at the voice of the one who reproaches and speaks evil, at the face of the enemy and pursuer.
All this has come upon us, yet we have not forgotten you; we have not been false to your covenant.
Nor have we turned back in our heart, yet you have turned our steps aside from your way.
For you have brought us low in an evil place, and the shadow of death has covered us.
If we had forgotten the name of our God, or had stretched out our hands to idols,
God would surely have searched this out, for he knows the secrets of the heart.
For your sake we are slain every day, and we are counted as sheep for slaughter.
Awake! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise, and do not cast us off completely.
Why do you turn your face away from me, and forget our poverty and our affliction?
For our soul has been brought low to the dust, and our belly has reached the ground.
Arise, God, help us, and deliver us for your name's sake.
My heart has uttered a good thing, and I will tell my works to the king; my tongue is like the pen of a skilled scribe.
He is beautiful to behold, more than all the sons of men; grace has been poured out from your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
Gird your sword upon your loins, mighty one, in your beauty and your goodness,
Bend your bow, go forward and reign, for the sake of truth and peace and righteousness. Your right hand shall lead you wondrously.
Your arrows are sharpened, mighty one; peoples have fallen beneath you, into the heart of the king's enemies.
God, your throne is forever and ever, the rod of your governance and the rod of your reign.
You have loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of joy more than your companions.
Myrrh, stacte and cassia come from your adornment, from palaces of ivory, with which they have gladdened you.
Daughters of kings have been made worthy of honor; you have set the queen at your right hand, clothed in a garment of gold, adorned and clothed, beautiful in many ways.
Listen, daughter, and see, and incline your ear. Forget your people and your father's house.
Let the king desire your beauty, for he himself is the Lord your God.
You shall bow down to him, and the daughter of Tyre too shall bow down to him; with gifts the rich among the people shall serve before his face.
All the glory of the king's daughter is within; she is adorned and clothed with golden fringes.
Her virgins shall be brought to the king, and after her, her companions shall be brought to him.
They shall bring them with joy and singing, and lead them into the palaces of the king.
In place of your fathers shall be your children; you shall appoint them rulers over all the earth.
They shall remember your name in every generation; therefore the peoples shall confess you forever and ever.
Our God is a refuge, strength, and a helper in the afflictions that have greatly found us.
Therefore I will not be afraid at the trembling of the earth, at the shifting of the mountains and at the heart of the seas.
Their waters roared and were troubled; the mountains trembled at his might.
The courses of the rivers gladden the city of God; the Most High has sanctified his dwelling place.
God is in their midst, and they will not be shaken. God will help from morning to morning.
The nations trembled, kings were humbled; the Most High gave forth his voice, and the earth shook.
The Lord God of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is the one who holds us by the hand.
Come and see the works of God, the wonders and signs he has done on the earth.
He made war cease from end to end of the earth; he shattered bows, ground weapons to powder, and burned shields with fire.
Be still and understand that I am God. I have been exalted over the nations, and I will be exalted over the earth.
The Lord God of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is the one who upholds us by the hand.
Clap your hands, all you nations, and cry out to God with a voice of joy.
For the Lord is high and terrible, and our king is great over all the earth.
He has subjected peoples under us and nations under our feet.
He has chosen us as his inheritance, and the beauty of Jacob, whom he loved.
God has gone up with shouting, and the Lord with the sound of the trumpet.
Let us sing praise to our God, let us sing praise to our King, let us sing praise;
for God is the great King over all the earth; let us sing praise to him with understanding.
God reigns over the nations; God has sat down on the thrones of his holiness.
The rulers gathered to the God of Abraham, for the mighty ones of God have been greatly exalted from the earth.
Great is the Lord and greatly praised in the city of our God and on his holy mountain.
Firmly founded, let it rejoice over all the earth: the mountains of Zion, the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
God is made manifest in his holy temple at the time when he helps them.
For behold, the kings of the earth gathered and came together.
They saw it thus and were amazed; they were afraid and trembled;
and trembling seized them; there was pain there, as of a woman in childbirth.
With a fierce wind they shattered the ships of Tarshish.
As we have heard, so also have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God; God has established them forever.
We have received your mercy, O God, in the midst of your people.
As your name is, O God, so is your praise over all the earth; your right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion rejoice and let the daughters of Judah be glad because of your judgments, O Lord.
Approach Zion, go around it, and tell of its towers.
Set your hearts on its strength and divide up its towers, so that you may be able to tell of it to another generation.
For this is God, our God forever and ever, and he will shepherd us forever.
Hear this, all you nations, and heed [?] me, all you inhabitants of the world,
you who are born of the earth, sons of men, rich and poor together.
My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditations of my heart understanding.
I will incline my ear to a parable and will make known the parables of song.
Why should I be afraid on the evil day? The iniquities of my steps have surrounded me.
Those who trust in their strength boast in the abundance of their wealth.
A brother cannot redeem; a man cannot redeem him; he has not given God a ransom for himself,
nor a price as ransom for his soul, though he should toil forever
and live completely. You shall not see corruption,
when they see the wise die. The foolish and the wicked shall perish together and leave their wealth to strangers.
Their temples were their houses forever, their dwelling place from generation to generation; their names shall be spoken in their land.
Man was in honor and did not understand. He imitated the senseless beasts and became like them.
This is the way of their stumbling toward them, and after this they shall take pleasure with their mouth.
Like sheep they were given over to hell, and death shepherded them; the upright shall rule over them at dawn, and their help shall waste away [?] in hell, and they fell from their glory.
But God will redeem my soul from the hands of hell, when he receives me.
Do not be afraid when a man grows rich, when the honor of his house increases;
for in his death he shall not carry away everything, nor shall the glory of his house go down with him.
But his soul will be blessed only in his lifetime; he will confess you when you do good to him.
He will enter the generation of his fathers; he will never see light again.
Man was in honor and did not understand; he imitated the senseless beasts and became like them.
The God of gods, the Lord, spoke and called all the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting.
Out of Zion comes the beauty of his splendor.
God will come openly, and our God will not keep silent. Fire will blaze up before him, and around him a mighty storm.
He will call to the heavens above and to the earth, to judge his people,
and to gather to him all his holy ones, who offer the sacrifice of the covenant upon the altar.
The heavens declare his righteousness, for God is judge.
Hear, my people, I am speaking to you; and Israel, I will testify to you, for I am God, your God.
It is not for your sacrifices that I judge you, for your offerings are before me always.
I will not accept young bulls from your house, nor goats from your flock.
For every beast of the forest is mine, the wild animals of the mountains and all the cattle.
I know the birds of the sky, and the beauty of the fields is with me.
If I should be hungry, I would not tell you; for the whole world is mine, with all that fills it.
I do not eat the flesh of your young bulls, nor do I drink the blood of your goats.
Offer to God a sacrifice of praise, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
Call on me in the day of your distress; I will deliver you, and you will glorify me.
But to the sinner God said: Now how can you recite my righteous decrees and take up my covenant in your mouth?
See, you have hated instruction; you have cast away and scattered all the words of my mouth.
If you saw a thief, you ran along with him, and you cast your lot with fornicators.
Your mouth multiplied wickedness, and your tongue contrived deceit.
You sat and spoke evil about your brother, and you laid a stumbling block for your mother's son.
All this you did, and I kept silent toward you; you suppose, lawless one, in your heart, that I would be like you. Now I will reprove you and set all this out before you.
Understand this, all you who have forgotten God, lest he snatch you away somewhere and there be no one to deliver you.
The sacrifice of praise will glorify me, and there is the way where I will show them my salvation.
Have mercy on me, O God, according to your great mercy, and by your many compassions blot out my lawlessness.
Wash me still more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sins.
For I know my iniquity, and my sin is before me always.
Against you alone have I sinned, O Lord, and I have done evil before you, so that you are righteous in your word and prevail in your judgment.
Behold, in lawlessness she conceived, and in sin my mother bore me,
O Lord, you have loved truth; the unseen and hidden things of your wisdom you have revealed to me.
Sprinkle me with your sprinkler and I shall be cleansed; wash me and I shall be made whiter than snow.
Let me hear song and joy, and the humbled bones will rejoice.
Turn your face away from my sins, and blot out all my lawless deeds.
Create a pure heart in me, O God, and renew an upright spirit in my body.
Do not cast me away from your face, and do not take your Holy Spirit from me.
Give me the joy of your salvation, and establish me with the Holy Spirit.
I will teach the lawless your ways, and the ungodly will turn to you.
Deliver me from blood, O God, God of my life; my tongue sings of your righteousness.
O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will speak your praise.
If you had wished it, we would have offered sacrifice to you; burnt offering you did not desire.
The sacrifice of God is a humble spirit; a pure heart and a humble spirit God will not despise.
Do good, O Lord, in your will to Zion, and let the walls of Jerusalem be built.
Then you will desire the sacrifice of righteousness, oblation and burnt offering; then young bulls will be offered upon your altar.
Why do you boast in wickedness, O mighty one, in iniquity every day?
His tongue plots falsehood; like a sword he has sharpened deceit.
He has loved lawlessness more than goodness, and falsehood more than the word of righteousness.
He has loved every word of destruction and a deceitful tongue.
Therefore God will destroy him utterly; he will pluck him up and drive him out from his dwellings, and his roots from the land of the living.
The righteous will see and be afraid, and they will laugh at him and say:
Behold the man for whom God was not a helper, but he trusted in his great wealth and grew strong in his great wickedness.
But I am like a fruitful olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the mercy of God forever and ever.
I will give thanks to you forever, for you have acted; I will wait patiently for your name, for you are sweet before your holy ones.
The fool said in his heart: There is no God. They have become corrupt and defiled in their lawlessness; there is no one who does good.
God looked down from heaven upon all the sons of men, to see whether there is anyone who understands or seeks after God.
All have turned aside together and become defiled; there is no one who does good, there is not even one.
All who commit lawlessness have not understood, those who devour my people as one eats bread; and they have not called upon God.
There they will be seized with fear, where there is no fear, for God has scattered the bones of those who please men; they will be put to shame, for God has despised them.
Who will give salvation to Israel from Zion? When the Lord brings back the captivity of his people, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.
O God, save me by your name, and judge my cause by your power.
O God, hear the prayer of my mouth; give ear to the words of my mouth.
For strangers have risen up against me, and the mighty have sought my soul. They have not regarded you, God, before them.
Behold, God is my helper, and the Lord is the upholder of my soul.
Turn back the evil upon my enemies; destroy them by your truth.
And of my own will I will offer sacrifice to you; I will give thanks to your name, O Lord, for it is good;
For you have delivered me from all my affliction, and my eye will look upon my enemies.
Give ear, O God, to my prayer, and do not disregard my supplication.
Look upon me and hear me, for I was distressed in my anxiety and I trembled
at the voice of the enemy and at the oppression of the sinner, for they brought wickedness upon me and spoke against me in anger.
My heart trembled within me, and the fear of death fell upon me.
Fear and trembling came upon me, and darkness covered me.
And I said: Who would give me wings like a dove's? I would fly up and rise on high.
I would go far away, I would depart and find rest in the wilderness.
I waited for God, my Savior, to save me from faintness of spirit caused by wrath and from the anguish of the storm wind.
Swallow them up, Lord, and scatter their tongues, for I have seen lawlessness and contention in the city.
Day and night it surrounds its walls; lawlessness, wickedness and sin are in its midst.
Usury and deceit have not been lacking from their streets.
For if an enemy had reproached me, I would have endured him; and if one who hates me had spoken boastfully against me, I would have hidden from him.
But now you, man, my companion, my leader and my acquaintance,
together, you and I, you made our food sweet, for we walked in unity in the house of God.
Let death come upon them, and let them go down alive into hell; for wickedness was in their dwelling and in their midst.
I called to God, and the Lord heard me;
evening, morning and noon I would recount and speak, and he will hear my voice.
Deliver my soul in peace from those who are near me, for they were deceitful toward me.
God will hear and will humble them, he who is before the ages. For there was no exchange for them, nor did they fear God.
He stretched out his hand to repay them, for they defiled his law.
They were divided by the wrath of his face, and it reached their heart; their words were softer than oil, yet they were like arrowheads.
Cast upon the Lord the thought of your heart, and he will nourish you; he will not let the righteous be shaken forever.
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction; let the days of bloody and deceitful men not be halved [?]. But I, Lord, trust in you.
Have mercy on me, God, for man has trampled me; all day long they have afflicted me with warfare.
My enemies have trampled me all day long; for those who fight against me from on high have multiplied.
By day I will not be afraid, for I trust in the Lord.
Through God I will praise my words; I trust in God, I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
All day long they abhorred my words, and all their thoughts concerning me were for evil.
Let them become strangers and hide themselves, for they watched my heel, so that they might lie in wait for my soul.
Therefore for nothing you will save them, and in wrath you will destroy the people, God.
I have told you my life; let me set my tears before you, as you promised me.
Then let my enemies turn back, on the day that I call on you; behold, I have come to know that you, God, are my God.
I will bless God with my word, and I will praise the Lord with my speech.
In God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Accept my vow, O God, the vow of praise which I have given to you;
for you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling, so that I may be pleasing before the Lord in the world of the living.
Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me, for my soul trusts in you; in the shelter of your wings I trust, until lawlessness passes away.
I cried out to God Most High, to God my benefactor.
