Our fathers in Egypt did not understand your wonders and did not remember your many mercies; they angered you at the crossing of the Red Sea.
He saved them for the sake of his name, so that they might understand his mighty deeds.
He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up, and he led them through the depths as through a desert.
He delivered them from the hand of those who hated them and rescued them from the hands of their enemies.
The water covered their oppressors, and not one of them escaped.
They believed his word and sang his praise.
They hastened to forget the works of God and did not wait for his counsel.
The spirit spoke desire in the wilderness, and they put God to the test in the waterless land.
He gave them what they asked for and sent fullness to their soul.
They provoked Moses to anger in their camp, and Aaron, the holy one of the Lord.
The earth opened and swallowed Dathan, and it covered the camp of Abiram;
fire blazed up in their assembly, and the flame burned up the sinners.
They made a calf at Horeb and worshiped that idol;
they exchanged their glory for the likeness of a calf that eats hay.
They forgot the God of their salvation, who did great things in the land of Egypt,
his wonders in the land of Ham and his terrible deeds at the Red Sea.
He spoke of destroying them, had not Moses, his chosen one, stood before him; he turned toward his face and turned away his wrath, so that they would not be destroyed.
They despised the desirable land and did not believe his word;
they murmured in their camp and did not listen to the voice of the Lord.
He raised his hand against them, to strike them down in the wilderness,
to strike down their descendants among the nations and to scatter them among the lands.
They defiled themselves through Baal-Peor and ate the offerings [?] of the dead [?].
They provoked him to anger with their deeds, and destruction multiplied upon them.
Phinehas stood up and delivered them, and death was stopped;
and it was counted to him as righteousness from generation to generation and forever.
They provoked him to anger at the waters of contention, and Moses fared badly because of them,
for they embittered his spirit; he gave command with his lips.
And he did not destroy the nations of which the Lord had told him.
They mingled with the nations and learned their deeds;
they served that idol, and it became a stumbling block to them;
they sacrificed their sons and daughters to demons.
And they shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idol of Canaan; they defiled the land with their blood.
They defiled themselves by their deeds, for they committed fornication in their ways.
The Lord was enraged with anger against his people, and he abhorred his inheritance.
He gave them into the hands of their enemies, and those who hated them ruled over them.
And their enemies oppressed them, and they were humbled under their hand.
Many times he delivered them, but they embittered him with their counsel, and they were humbled by their lawlessness.
The Lord looked upon their affliction when he heard the voice of their prayer.
He remembered his covenant forever and relented in his great mercy.
He caused them to be pitied before all who had taken them captive.
Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and boast in your praise.
Blessed is the Lord God of Israel forever and ever and ever. And let all the people say: So be it, so be it.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his mercy endures forever.
Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, those whom he redeemed from the hands of the enemy,
and gathered from all lands, from the rising of the sun to its setting, from the north and from the sea.
They strayed in the wilderness, trackless and waterless, and they did not find the way to a city where they could dwell.
They were hungry and thirsty, and their soul fainted within them.
They cried out to the Lord in their affliction, and he delivered them from their distresses.
He led them on a straight road, that they might enter the city of their dwelling.
Give thanks to the Lord for his mercies and for his wonders toward the sons of men,
for he has satisfied the empty soul and filled the hungry soul with good things.
Those who sat in darkness and in the shadows of death were bound with poverty as with iron,
for they had embittered the words of God and provoked the counsel of the Most High to anger.
Their hearts were humbled by toil; they grew weak, and there was no one to deliver them.
They cried out to the Lord in their affliction, and he rescued them from their distresses.
He brought them out of darkness and the shadows of death and burst their bonds apart.
Give thanks to the Lord for his mercies and for his wonders toward the sons of men,
for he has shattered the gates of bronze and broken the bolts of iron.
He helped them out of the way of their lawlessness, for they had been humbled by their sin.
And their soul loathed all their food, and they drew near to the gates of death.
They cried out to the Lord in their affliction, and he saved them from their anguish.
He sent his holy word and healed them, and he delivered them from their corruption.
Give thanks to the Lord for his mercies and for his wonders, you sons of men.
Let them offer him the sacrifice of praise and recount his works with joy.
Those who travel the sea in ships and do their work on many waters,
they see the works of God, his powers and his wonders in the depths and the abysses.
He spoke, and the storm wind arose, and its waves were lifted high;
they go up to heaven, they go down to the abyss, and their soul melted away in distress.
They trembled like drunken men, and all their wisdom was swallowed up.
They cried out to the Lord in their affliction, and he brought them out of their anguish.
He turned his storm winds into a breeze, and its waves grew calm;
and they rejoiced because it had become still, and he led them to the haven of their desire.
Give thanks to the Lord for his mercies and for his wonders, you sons of men.
Let them exalt him in the assembly of the people and praise him in the seats of the elders.
For he turned rivers into dry land and springs of water into thirsty ground,
he made fruitful land into a salt waste because of the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
He turned deserts into pools of water and thirsty land into springs of water;
he settled the hungry there, and they built cities to live in,
they sowed fields and planted a vineyard and produced a fruitful yield.
He blessed them and they multiplied greatly, and their livestock did not decrease.
They were diminished and brought to misery by the affliction of evils and pains.
Contempt came upon their rulers, and they went astray in the wilderness and in a place without a road.
He helped the poor man in his destitution and led their tribes like a flock.
Let the upright see it and rejoice, and let the mouth of all the lawless be shut.
Who is wise and will keep these things, and will understand the mighty acts of the Lord?
My heart is prepared toward you, O God, my heart is prepared; I will praise you and sing to you with your glory.
Awake, my glory, awake with psalm and blessing. And I will awake at dawn.
I will give thanks to you among the people, O Lord, and sing to you among the nations,
for your mercy has grown great up to the heavens, and your truth reaches to the clouds.
You are exalted in the heavens, O God, and your glory is over all the earth.
So that those who love you may be saved, save me with your right hand and hear me.
God spoke from his holy place: I will rejoice and be exalted; I will divide Shechem and measure out the valley of dwellings.
Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine, Ephraim is the strengthener of my head, Judah is my king,
Moab is the washbasin of my hope; my going has been directed as far as Idumea, and I have subdued the foreign tribes.
Who will bring me to that fortified city? Or who will lead me as far as Idumea,
if not you, O God, who scattered us and did not go out, O God, as strength for us?
Give us help in affliction, for the salvation of man is vain.
Through God let us act with might, and he will put all our enemies to shame.
O God, do not keep silent at my praise;
for the mouth of the sinner and the mouth of the deceitful has been opened against me; they spoke about me with deceitful lips;
with hateful words they hated me, and they fought against me without cause.
In return for my love they slandered me, but I prayed.
They repaid me with evil in return for good, and with hatred in return for my love.
Set a sinner over him, and let the devil stand at the right hand of the son [?].
From his judgment let him come out thwarted, and let his prayer be reckoned to him as sin.
Let his days be few, and let another take his office.
Let his children be orphans and his wife a widow.
Let his children be stirred up and removed, let them become beggars for bread, and let them be driven out from their dwelling place.
Let the lender seize everything that he has, and let foreigners plunder their labor.
Let him find no helper, nor anyone to take in his orphans;
May his offspring be given over to destruction among the people, and may his name be blotted out from the generation.
May the sin of their father be remembered before the Lord, and may the sin of their mother not be blotted out.
May they be before the Lord always, and may their memory be destroyed from the earth,
because he did not remember to show mercy; he persecuted a man in distress, poor, and he killed the lowly in heart.
He loved cursing, and it came upon him; he did not want blessing, and it went far from him.
He put on cursing like a garment; it went down like water into his bowels and like oil into his bones.
May cursing be to him like a garment that he puts on and like a belt that he girds around his loins.
This is the work of those who slander me to the Lord and who speak evil against my soul.
But you, Lord, Lord, act on my behalf for your name's sake, for your mercy is sweet.
Deliver me, for I am poor and fallen, for my heart has trembled within my body.
And I have faded away like a shadow when the sun declines; I have been shaken off like a locust.
My knees have grown weak from fasting, and my flesh has been changed for lack of oil.
I have become a reproach to them; they saw me and shook their heads.
Help me, Lord my God, and save me by your mercy.
Let them understand that this is your hand and that you, Lord, have done this.
They curse me, but you will bless me; and let those who have risen against me be ashamed, but let your servant rejoice in you.
Let those who have risen up against me to speak evil put on shame and disgrace, and let them be clothed with their shame as with a double garment.
I will give great thanks to the Lord with my mouth, and in the midst of many I will praise him,
for he stood at the right hand of the poor man, to deliver my soul from those who persecute me.
The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right hand, until I place your enemies beneath your feet.
The Lord will send out to you the rod of power from Zion, and you shall rule in the midst of your enemies.
With you is dominion in the days of your power, in the splendor of your holy ones; from the womb, before the morning star, I begot you.
The Lord swore and did not repent: You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.
The Lord is at your right hand; he has shattered kings on the day of wrath;
he will judge the nations and fill them with corpses; he will shatter the heads of many upon the earth.
He will drink from the torrent by the way; therefore he will lift up the head.
I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart, in the counsel of the upright and among the people.
Great are the works of God; his commandments are to be searched out in every way.
Worthy of praise and greatly beautiful are his works, and his righteousness shall stand forever and ever.
He made a memorial of his wonders, the merciful and compassionate Lord.
He gave food to those who fear him; he remembered his covenant forever.
He told his people the power of his works, to give them the inheritance of the nations.
The works of his hands are righteousness and judgment; his commandments are faithful in every way,
they are established forever and ever, made in truth and judgment.
He sent redemption to his people; he commanded his covenant forever; for holy and fearsome is his name.
For the beginning of wisdom is the fear of the Lord; good understanding belongs to all who do it, and his praise shall stand forever.
Blessed is the man who fears the Lord and greatly desires his commandments;
his kin shall be mighty on the earth, and the seed of the upright shall be blessed;
glory and wealth to his name, and his righteousness shall stand forever.
The light of the upright has shone forth in the darkness, merciful, compassionate, righteous.
The gentle man shows mercy and lends, and he will order his words in judgment.
For he will not be shaken forever; the righteous man will be an everlasting memorial.
He shall not be afraid of evil news; his heart is prepared in hope of the Lord.
His heart is established and he shall not be afraid, until he sees that of his enemies [?].
He scattered and gave it to the poor, and his righteousness shall stand forever; his horn shall be exalted in glory.
The sinner shall see and be enraged; he shall gnash his teeth and melt away, and the desire of sinners shall perish.
Praise the Lord, you children, praise the name of the Lord.
May the name of the Lord be blessed from now on and forever.
From the rising of the sun to the setting of the sun, the name of the Lord is praised.
The Lord is high above all peoples, and his glory is in the heavens.
Who is like the Lord our God, who dwells on high
and looks upon the lowly things of heaven and of earth?
He raises up the poor from the earth and lifts up the fallen from the dung heaps,
to seat them as rulers with the rulers of his people;
he settled the barren woman in a house in gladness, as a mother made joyful by children.
When Israel came out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign seed,
Judea became his sanctuary and Israel his dominion.
The sea saw and fled, and the Jordan turned back.
The mountains rejoiced like rams, and the hills like lambs of the flock.
What is the matter with you, O sea, that you saw and fled, or with you, O Jordan, that you turned back?
The mountains rejoiced like rams, and the hills like lambs of the flock.
Before the face of the Lord the earth was shaken, before the face of the God of Jacob,
who turned rocks into a lake of waters and the peaks of mountains into springs of waters.
Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory, for the sake of your mercy and your truth.
Lest the nations should say, Where is that God of theirs?
But our God, in the heavens and upon the earth, has done all that he wills.
The idols of the nations are of gold and of silver, made by the hands of men;
they have a mouth and do not speak, they have eyes and do not see,
they have ears and do not hear, they have a nose and do not smell,
they have hands and do not act, they have feet and do not walk, nor do they cry out with their throat.
May those who make them become like them, and all who trust in them.
The house of Israel has hoped in the Lord; he is their helper and protector.
The house of Aaron has hoped in the Lord; he is their helper and protector.
Those who fear the Lord have hoped in the Lord; he is their helper and defender.
The Lord has remembered us and has blessed us. The Lord has blessed the house of Israel, the Lord has blessed the house of Aaron,
The Lord has blessed those who fear him, the small together with the great.
May the Lord add to you, to you and to your children;
blessed are you by the Lord, who made the heavens and the earth.
The heavens of heavens are the Lord's, and the earth he has given to the sons of men.
It is not the dead who will praise you, O Lord, nor any of those who go down to hell.
But we the living will bless your name from now on and forever.
I have loved, because the Lord has heard the voice of my prayer.
For he has inclined his ear to me, and in my days I would call upon him.
The pangs of death surrounded me, and the afflictions of hell found me; I found affliction and pain.
And I called on the name of the Lord: O Lord, deliver my soul.
The Lord is merciful and righteous, and our God is compassionate.
The Lord protects the little ones; I was brought low, and he saved me.
Return, my soul, to your place of rest, for the Lord will do you good.
For he has delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling,
that I may be pleasing before the Lord in the world of the living.
I believed, and so I spoke; but I was greatly humbled.
I said in my amazement: Every man is a liar.
What shall I repay to the Lord for all that he has given me?
I will take up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord.
I will render my prayers to the Lord before all his people.
Precious before the Lord is the death of his saints.
O Lord, I am your servant, I am your servant and the son of your handmaid; you have broken my bonds,
to you I will offer the sacrifice of praise, and I will call on the name of the Lord.
I will render my prayers to the Lord before all his people,
in the courts of the house of our God and in your midst, O Jerusalem!
Sing to the Lord, all nations, and praise him, all peoples;
for his mercy has grown strong over us, and the truth of the Lord endures forever.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his mercy is forever;
let the house of Israel say: for he is good, for his mercy is forever;
let the house of Aaron say: for he is good, for his mercy is forever;
let those who fear the Lord say: for he is good, for his mercy is forever.
In my distress I called to the Lord; he heard me and brought me out into a broad place.
The Lord is my helper, I shall not be afraid; what can a man do to me?
The Lord will help me, and I shall see what befalls my enemies.
Better is hope in the Lord than hope in men;
better is hope in the Lord than hope in rulers.
All the nations surrounded me, and by the name of the Lord I fought them off.
Pressing in, they pressed upon me and encircled me, and by the name of the Lord I fought them off;
they pressed upon me like bees and burned up like thorns in fire, and by the name of the Lord I fought them off.
I was forced to give way and was about to fall, and the Lord took me by the hand and lifted me up.
My strength and my song is the Lord, and he is my savior.
The voice of joy and salvation is in the dwelling of the righteous. The right hand of the Lord has done mightily;
the right hand of the Lord has lifted me up, and the right hand of the Lord has done mightily.
I shall not die, but I shall live and declare the works of the Lord.
The Lord has disciplined me with discipline, but he has not given me over to death.
Open to me, gates of righteousness. I shall enter by them and give thanks to the Lord.
These are the gates of the Lord, and the righteous shall enter by them.
I shall give thanks to you, for you heard me and became my savior.
The stone which the builders rejected has become the head of the corner;
this was from the Lord, and it is marvelous before our eyes.
This is the day which the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
O Lord, save me; O Lord, make my way prosper,
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord; may the house of the Lord bless us.
God is the Lord, and he has appeared to us; let us prepare a feast of joy at the time of blossoms, up to the edge of the altar.
You are my God, and I will give thanks to you, Lord; you are our God, and I will exalt you; I will give thanks to you, for you heard me and became my savior.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his mercy endures forever.
Blessed are those who are blameless in the way, who walk in the judgment of the Lord.
Blessed are those who search out his testimonies; with all their heart they shall seek him.
For those who work lawlessness have not walked in his ways.
You have commanded that your commandments be kept diligently.
May my ways be directed to keep your righteous decrees.
Then I shall not be put to shame, when I heed all your commandments.
I will give thanks to you, Lord, with an upright heart, when you have taught me the judgments of your righteousness.
I will keep your righteous decrees; do not forsake me utterly.
How shall a young man make his ways straight? Only if he keeps your words.
With all my heart I will seek you; do not put me far from your commandments.
In my heart I have hidden your words, so that I may not sin against you.
Blessed are you, Lord; teach me your righteous decrees.
With my lips let me recount all the judgments of your mouth.
Let me delight in the way of your testimonies as in all riches.
Let me meditate on your commandments, and I will heed your ways.
I spoke of your righteous decrees, and I will not forget your words.
Reward your servant, that I may live and keep your words.
Enlighten my eyes, and I shall behold the wonders of your law.
I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide [?] your commandments from me.
My soul has longed to desire your judgments at all times.
You have rebuked the proud; cursed are those who have turned away from your commandments.
Remove from me reproach and contempt, for I have sought out your testimonies.
For princes sat down and spoke evil against me, but your servant meditated on your statutes.
For your testimonies are my discipline, and your statutes are my counsel.
My soul has drawn near to the earth; give me life by your word.
I told you my ways, and you heard me; teach me your statutes.
Make me understand the ways of your righteousness, and I will meditate on your wonders.
My soul has slumbered from weariness; strengthen me by your word.
Remove the way of falsehood from me, and by your law have mercy on me.
I have sought out the ways of your truth, and I have not forgotten your statutes.
I have clung to your testimonies; Lord, do not put me to shame.
I ran in the way of your commandments when you enlarged my heart.
Instruct me in the law, Lord, in the ways of your righteousness, and I will seek them out always.
Give me understanding, and I will search out your law and keep it with my whole heart.
Lead me on the path of your commandments, for I have delighted in it.
Incline my heart to your testimonies and not to greed.
Turn away my eyes so that they do not look on vanity, and give me life in your way.
Establish your word with your servant, so that I may fear you.
Take away from me the reproach that I dread, for your judgments are sweet.
Behold, my heart has told me of your commandments; teach me your statutes.
Let your mercy come upon me, Lord, and your salvation according to your word.
I will give an answer to those who reproach me, for I trust in your words.
Do not take the words of your truth utterly away from my mouth, for I hope in your judgments.
I will keep your law always, forever and ever and ever.
And I walked in a broad place, for I have sought out your commandments.
I spoke of your testimonies before kings, and I was not ashamed.
I meditated on your commandments, which I have loved.
I lifted up my hands to your commandments, which I have loved, and I meditated on your righteous decrees.
Remember your word to your servant, by which you have given me hope.
This comforted me in my humiliation, for your word has given me life.
The proud acted very lawlessly, but I did not turn aside from your law.
I remembered your judgments from of old, Lord, and I was comforted.
Anguish seized me because of the sinners and those who have abandoned your law.
Your judgments were songs of praise to me in the place of my sojourning.
I remembered your name in the night, Lord, and I kept your law.
This has become for me the way of life, for I have sought out your judgments.
You are my portion, Lord, I said, that I may keep your law.
I entreated your face with all my heart; have mercy on me according to your word.
I pondered your ways, and I turned my feet to your testimonies.
I made myself ready and was not dismayed, for I have kept your commandments.
The mouths of the net of sin closed around me, yet I did not forget your law.
At midnight I rose to give thanks to you for the judgments of your righteousness.
I am a companion of all who fear you and of those who keep your commandments.
The earth is full of the mercy of the Lord; teach me your righteous decrees.
Deal kindly with your servant, Lord, according to your word.
Teach me kindness, instruction, and knowledge, for I have believed your commandments.
Before I was humbled, I sinned; therefore I have kept your word.
You are kind, Lord, and in your kindness teach me your righteous decrees.
The falsehood of the proud has multiplied against me, but with all my heart I have sought out your commandments.
Their heart has curdled like milk, but I spoke of your law.
It is good for me that you humbled me, so that I might learn your righteous decrees.
Better to me is the law of your mouth, O Lord, than those thousands of gold and silver.
Your hands made me and formed me; give me understanding, and I shall learn your commandments.
Those who fear you saw me and rejoiced, for I put my hope in your words.
I have understood, O Lord, that your judgments are in righteousness, and in truth you humbled me.
Let your mercy be my comforter, according to your word to your servant.
Let your mercies come upon me, O Lord, and I shall live, for your law is my meditation.
Let the proud be put to shame, for they acted lawlessly toward me with falsehood, but I meditated on your commandments.
Let those who fear you teach me, and those who know your testimonies.
Let my heart be blameless in your statutes, so that I may not be put to shame.
My soul has failed for your salvation, for I put my hope in your words.
My eyes waited for your word, and I said, When will you comfort me?
I have become like a wineskin in the frost, yet I have not forgotten your righteous decrees.
How many are the days of your servant? Or when will you execute judgment for me on my persecutors?
The lawless told me idle talk, but it was not like your law.
All your commandments are in truth. They persecuted me without cause; help me.
A little more and they would have destroyed me on the earth, yet I did not abandon your commandments.
By your mercy save me, and I shall keep the testimonies of your mouth.
Forever, O Lord, your word abides in heaven.
From generation to generation is your truth; you established the earth, and it stands.
The day waits upon your command, for all things serve you.
If your law had not been my meditation, then I would have perished in my humiliation.
Never shall I forget your righteous decrees, for in this you saved me.
I am yours; save me, for I have sought out your commandments.
Sinners watched for me to destroy me, for I have understood your testimonies.
I have seen the limit of every end; your commandments are exceedingly broad.
How I have loved your law, O Lord, for every day they are my discourse.
Make me more knowing in your commandments than my enemies, for they are mine forever.
Give me more understanding than my teachers, for your testimonies have been my meditation.
Give me more understanding than the elders, for I have searched out your commandments.
I have held back my feet from every evil way, so that I may keep your words.
I have not turned aside from your judgments, for you have instructed me in the law.
For your words are sweet to my palate, more than honey to my mouth.
From your commandments I have gained understanding; therefore I have hated every way of falsehood.
Your word, O Lord, is a lamp to my feet and a light to my paths.
I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep all the judgments of your righteousness.
I have been greatly humbled; O Lord, save me by your word.
Be pleased, O Lord, with the willing offering of my mouth, and teach me your righteous ordinances.
My soul is in your hands always, and I have not forgotten your law.
Sinners have set a snare for me, yet I have not strayed from your commandments.
I have taken your testimonies as my inheritance forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
I have humbled myself to carry out your judgments, for the sake of the everlasting reward.
I have hated the lawless, but I have loved your law.
You are my helper and the one who holds me by the hand, and I trust in your words.
Depart from me, you evil ones, and I will search out the commandments of my God.
Help me by your word, save me, and do not put me to shame in my hope.
Help me, and I shall be saved, and I will speak of your righteous ordinances at all times.
You have despised all who have departed from you, for all their thoughts were in falsehood.
I have counted all the sinners of the earth as guilty; therefore I have loved your testimonies.
I have nailed my flesh to the fear of you, for I have been greatly afraid of your judgments.
Do judgment and justice, and [?] hand me over into the hand of those who harm me.
Receive your servant in your goodness, and let not the proud slander me.
My eyes wait for your salvation and for the words of your righteousness.
Deal with your servant according to your mercy, and teach me your statutes.
I am your servant; give me knowledge, and I will understand your testimonies.
It is time to serve the Lord, for they have done away with your law.
Therefore I have loved your testimonies more than gold and topaz;
therefore I was directed toward all your commandments, and I have hated every way of falsehood.
Your testimonies are wonderful; therefore my soul has searched them out.
The revealing of your words gives light and makes infants wise.
I opened my mouth and drew breath, for I longed for your commandments.
Look upon me and have mercy on me, according to the judgments for those who love your name.
Direct my steps by your word, and let no iniquity have dominion over me.
Deliver me from the slander of men, and I will keep your commandments.
Show your face upon your servant and teach me your statutes.
Streams of water ran down from my eyes, because I did not keep your law.
You are righteous, O Lord, and your judgments are upright.
You have commanded the righteousness of your testimonies, and it is very true.
Your zeal has worn me away, for your enemies have forgotten your words.
Your word is exceedingly choice, and your servant has loved them.
I am young and despised, yet I have not forgotten your statutes.
Your righteousness is righteousness forever, and your law is true.
Afflictions and struggles have found me, and your commandments were my meditation.
Your judgments are in righteousness forever; give me understanding and save me.
I cried out to you with all my heart; hear me, O Lord, for I have sought out your statutes.
I cried out to you; save me, and I will keep your commandments.
I rose before dawn, at an untimely hour, and cried out, for I hope in your words.
My eyes woke before dawn, at daybreak, to meditate on your words.
Hear my voice, O Lord, by your mercy; O Lord, by your justice give me life.
My persecutors have brought lawlessness upon me, for they have gone far from your law.
You are near, O Lord, and all your commandments are in truth.
From the beginning I have known your testimonies, for you have established them forever.
See my lowliness and deliver me, for I have not forgotten your law.
Judge my cause and deliver me, and by your word give me life.
Salvation is far from sinners, for they have not sought out your ordinances.
Your mercies are many, O Lord; by your justice give me life.
Many are my persecutors and my oppressors, yet I have not turned aside from your testimonies.
I saw the unseemly ones and I melted away, for they did not keep your commandments.
See that I have kept your commandments, O Lord; by your mercy give me life.
The beginning of your words is truth; all the judgments of your righteousness endure forever.
Rulers persecuted me without cause, and my soul was afraid of your words.
I will rejoice in your word, like one who finds abundant spoil.
I have hated and abhorred sin, but I have loved your law.
Seven times a day I praise you for the judgments of your righteousness.
Great peace is with those who love your name, and there is no stumbling block for them.
I waited for your hope, O Lord, and I have loved your commandments.
My soul has kept your testimonies and has loved them greatly.
I have kept your commandments and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you, O Lord.
Let my prayer draw near before you, O Lord, and by your word give me understanding.
Let my supplication come in before you, O Lord, and by your word give me life.
Let my lips utter your praise, when you teach me your righteous decrees.
Let my tongue also speak your word, for all your commandments are in righteousness.
Let your hand be my savior, for I have chosen your commandments.
My soul has longed for your salvation, O Lord, and your law is my meditation.
Let my soul live and praise you, and let your judgments help me.
I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek out your servant, for I have not forgotten your commandments.
In my distress I cried out to the Lord, and he heard me.
O Lord, deliver my soul from lying lips and from a deceitful tongue.
What will the deceitful tongue give you, or what will it add to you?
Like the arrows of the mighty, for they are sharpened [?] with coals of desolation.
Woe is me, for my sojourning has been prolonged, and I have dwelt among those who live in Kedar.
For a long time my soul has dwelt among those who hate peace.
I was a peacemaker toward them; and when I spoke to them, they fought against me.
I lifted up my eyes to the mountains: from where will help come to me?
My help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
Do not let your feet be shaken, and let your keeper not slumber.
Behold, the keeper of Israel will not slumber, nor will he sleep.
The Lord will keep you; the Lord is your protector, and by his right hand.
The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
The Lord will keep you from all evil; the Lord will keep your soul.
The Lord will keep your coming in and your going out from now on and forever.
I rejoiced at those who said to me: Let us go into the house of the Lord.
My feet were standing in your courts, O Jerusalem.
Jerusalem is built, a city whose dwelling place is around it.
For there the tribes of the Lord went up, tribe by tribe, as a testimony [?] for Israel and to confess the name of the Lord;
For there the thrones of judgment were set, the thrones were set in the house of David.
Ask for the peace of Jerusalem and the prosperity of those who love you.
Let there be peace in your strength and prosperity in your mighty towers.
For the sake of my brothers and my companions I was speaking peace concerning you.
From the house of the Lord our God I have sought good for you.
To you, O Lord, I have lifted up my eyes, you who dwell in the heavens.
As the eyes of servants look to the hands of their masters, and as the eyes of a maidservant to the hands of her mistress, so too our eyes look to you, O Lord our God, until you have mercy on us.
Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us, for we have been filled with much contempt.
All the more has our soul been filled with the reproach of the rich and the contempt of the proud.
Had the Lord not been with us, let Israel say,
had the Lord not been with us when men rose up against us,
they would surely have swallowed us alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;
the waters would surely have swallowed us up; our soul passed through a torrent;
our soul passed through those restless waters.
Blessed is the Lord, who did not give us as prey to their teeth.
Our soul escaped like a sparrow from the snare of the hunters. The trap was broken, and we escaped.
Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion; it shall not be shaken forever. It is he who dwells in Jerusalem.
Mountains surround it, and the Lord surrounds his people from now on and forever.
For the Lord will not leave the rod of sinners upon the portion of the righteous, so that the righteous may not stretch out their hands to iniquity.
Do good, O Lord, to those who are good and upright in heart,
but those who turn aside to perversity, the Lord will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.
When the Lord turned back the captivity of Zion, we were comforted.
Then our mouth was filled with joy and our tongue with singing; then they will say among the nations: The Lord has done great things with them.
The Lord has done great things with us, and we became joyful.
Turn back our captivity, O Lord, like torrents in the south wind.
Those who sowed with tears, let them reap with joy.
Going, they went and wept, those who carried their seed; coming, they came and rejoiced, those who brought their sheaves.
Unless the Lord had built the house, its builders would have labored in vain; unless the Lord had guarded the city, its watchmen would have kept awake in vain.
In vain is your rising early; now rise, until you go to sleep, you who eat the bread of sorrow, when he gives sleep to his beloved.
For children are the inheritance of the Lord, and their reward is the fruit of the womb.
Like arrows in the hands of a mighty man, so are the sons of those who were cast out.
Blessed is he who fills his desire from them, and he will not be ashamed when their enemies speak to them at the gates.
Blessed are all who fear the Lord and who walk in his ways.
You shall eat the labor of your hands; may you be blessed, and may it be well with you.
Your wife is like a fruitful vine on the sides of your house; your children are like new olive plants around your table.
Behold, thus shall the man be blessed who fears the Lord.
May the Lord bless you from Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
May you see your children's children. Peace be upon Israel.
Many times they have fought against me from my youth, let Israel say,
many times they have fought against me from my youth, and they have not overcome me.
Sinners struck me on my shoulders, and they prolonged their lawlessness.
The righteous Lord will crush the necks of sinners.
Let all who hate Zion be ashamed and turned back.
Let them become like the grass of the rooftops, which withers before it is plucked,
with which the reaper did not fill his hand, nor his arm those who gather their sheaves.
And those who passed by did not say to them: The blessing of the Lord be with you; may the name of the Lord bless you.
From the depths I cry out to you, O Lord;
O Lord, hear my voice. May your ears be attentive to the voice of my prayer.
If you repay me according to my iniquities, O Lord, O Lord, who could withstand you?
For with you there is mercy.
For your name's sake I have waited for you, O Lord; my soul has waited for your word.
My soul hopes in the Lord from the morning watch until evening; from the morning watches let Israel hope in the Lord.
For with the Lord there is mercy, and with him there is redemption,
and he himself redeemed Israel from all its troubles.
O Lord, my heart was not lifted up, nor were my eyes haughty; I did not walk with the rich, nor with those more marvelous than I,
but I humbled myself, so that my soul might be lifted up; I became like a child weaned from its mother's milk, so that it might be repaid to my soul.
Let Israel hope in the Lord from now on and forever.
Remember, O Lord, David and all his meekness,
how he swore to the Lord and vowed to the God of Jacob:
I will not enter the dwelling of my house, nor go up onto the bedding of my couch,
I will not give sleep to my eye, nor slumber to my eyelids, nor rest to my flesh,
until I find a place for the Lord and a dwelling for the God of Jacob.
Behold, we heard of it from Euphrates, and we found it in the field of the groves.
Let us enter his dwellings and bow down at the place where his feet stood.
Arise, O Lord, to your resting place, you and the ark of your holiness.
Let your priests be clothed with righteousness, and let your holy ones rejoice with joy.
For the sake of David your servant, do not turn your face away from your anointed.
The Lord swore to David in his truth and will not lie to him: Of the fruit of your womb I will set one on your thrones.
If your children keep my law and my testimonies [?], which I have taught them, their offspring shall sit on your thrones forever and ever.
For the Lord has been pleased with Zion and has chosen it to dwell in:
This is my resting place forever; here I will dwell, for it pleases me.
I will bless its game with blessing, and I will satisfy its poor with bread.
I will clothe its priests with salvation, and its holy ones shall rejoice with joy.
There I will make a horn spring up for David and prepare a lamp for my anointed.
I will clothe his enemies with shame, but upon him my holiness will shine forth.
What is so good, or what is so beautiful, as brothers dwelling together in one?
It is like fragrant ointment flowing down upon the head and the beard of Aaron, down the beard that descends upon the shoulders of his garment;
like dew coming down from Hermon upon Mount Zion; for there the Lord has prepared blessing and life forever.
Here bless the Lord, all you servants of the Lord, bless the Lord, you who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.
By night lift up your hands toward the holy place and bless the Lord.
May the Lord bless you from Zion, he who made the heavens and the earth.
Praise the name of the Lord; praise the Lord, you servants of the Lord,
you who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.
Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good; sing to his name, for it is lovely;
for the Lord has chosen Jacob for himself, and Israel as his own dominion.
I have understood that the Lord is great, and our God is greater than all idols;
all that the Lord willed, he also did, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all the abysses;
he brings up the clouds from the end of the earth and turns lightnings into rain, he who brings forth the winds from his treasuries;
he who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, from man to beast;
he sent forth his wonders and his signs in your midst, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh and upon all his servants;
he who struck down many nations and slew mighty kings,
Sihon, king of the Amorites, Og, king of Bashan, and all the kings of the Canaanites;
he gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel his servant.
O Lord, your name endures forever; O Lord, your remembrance endures from generation to generation.
For the Lord will judge his people and will comfort his servants.
The idols of the nations are of gold and silver, made by the hands of men;
they have mouths and do not speak, they have eyes and do not see,
they have ears and do not hear, for there is no breath in their mouths.
May those who make them become like them, and all who trust in them.
House of Israel, bless the Lord; house of Aaron, bless the Lord;
house of Levi, bless the Lord; you who fear the Lord, bless the Lord.
Blessed is the Lord from Zion, he who dwells in Jerusalem.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his mercy endures forever;
give thanks to the God of gods, for he is good, for his mercy endures forever;
give thanks to the Lord of lords, for [?] he is good, for his mercy endures forever;
who alone has done great wonders, for his mercy endures forever;
who made the heavens by his understanding, for his mercy endures forever;
who established the earth upon the waters, for his mercy endures forever;
who alone made the great lights, for his mercy endures forever:
the sun to rule over the day, for his mercy endures forever,
the moon and the stars to rule over the night, for his mercy endures forever;
who struck Egypt together with its firstborn, for his mercy endures forever,
and brought Israel out from its midst, for his mercy endures forever,
with a strong hand and a raised arm, for his mercy endures forever;
who split the Red Sea in two, for his mercy endures forever,
and brought Israel out through the midst of it, for his mercy endures forever;
he plunged Pharaoh and his people into the Red Sea, for his mercy endures forever;
who led his people out into the wilderness, for his mercy endures forever;
who struck down great kings, for his mercy endures forever,
and slew mighty kings, for his mercy endures forever:
Sihon, king of the Amorites, for his mercy endures forever;
Og, king of Bashan, for his mercy endures forever;
he gave their land as an inheritance, for his mercy endures forever,
an inheritance to Israel, his people, for his mercy endures forever;
For in our lowliness the Lord remembered us, for his mercy is forever,
and he delivered us from the hands of our enemies, for his mercy is forever,
he who gives food to all flesh, for his mercy is forever.
Give thanks to the Lord of heaven, for he is good, for his mercy is forever.
By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat and wept, when we remembered Zion.
On the willows in its midst we hung our instrument of song;
for there those who took us captive asked us for words of song, and those who led us away said to us: Praise for us with that song of Zion!
How then shall we praise you with the song of the Lord in this foreign land?
If I forget you, Jerusalem, may your right hand also forget me!
May my tongue cleave to my palate, if I do not remember you and if I do not set you in order as you were at first, Jerusalem, as a pattern at the beginning of your joy!
Remember, Lord, the sons of Edom and that day of Jerusalem, those who said: Tear it down, tear it down to its foundation!
Daughter of Babylon, wretched one, blessed is he who repays you the recompense with which you repaid us!
Blessed is he who seizes your children and dashes them against the rock!
I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart, and before the angels I will sing to you, for you have heard the words of my mouth.
And I will worship you in your holy temple, and give thanks to your name for your mercy and for your truth, for you have magnified your holy name in every way.
On the day that I called upon you, you heard me swiftly, for you multiplied my soul with strength.
All the kings of the earth will give thanks to you, Lord, for they have heard the words of your mouth,
and they will sing of your ways, Lord, for great is the glory of the Lord.
For the Lord is high, he looks upon the lowly, and he knows the high from afar.
Though I walk in the midst of affliction, save me from the wrath of the enemy; stretch out your hand to me, and may your right hand save me.
The Lord will repay on my behalf; Lord, your mercy is forever; Lord, do not disregard the work of your hands.
Lord, you have tested me and known me;
you know my sitting down and my rising up; you have understood my thoughts from afar;
my places and my portions you have searched out, and all my ways you have foreseen;
for there is no deceit on my tongue;
Behold, O Lord, you have known my first and my last; you created me and laid your hand upon me.
Your knowledge has become too wondrous for me; it has grown strong, and I cannot attain to it.
Where shall I go from your Spirit, or where shall I flee from your face?
If I go up to heaven, you are there; and if I go down to hell, there too you are near;
if I lift up my hands at daybreak and settle at the end of the sea,
even there your hand will lead me, and your left hand will receive me.
And I said: Surely darkness will cover me, and the night will be in place of the light of my delight.
For darkness will not be dark because of you, and the night will be bright as the day; as its light is, so also is its darkness.
For you created my kidneys and received me from my mother's womb.
I will give thanks to you, O Lord, for you are fearfully wondrous; wondrous are your works, and my soul knows it very well.
My bone, which you made in secret, was not hidden from you, nor my substance in the lower parts of the earth.
What had not yet been done by me your eyes saw, and all this was written in your book; by day they went astray, and there was no one leading them.
To me your friends, O God, are greatly to be glorified, and their rulers have grown exceedingly strong.
I counted them, and they multiplied more than the sand; I awoke, and now I am with you.
If you would slay the sinners, O God! Remove bloodthirsty and deceitful men from me.
For with [?] and with envy, in vain they have seized your cities.
For those who hate you, O Lord, I have hated, and I wasted away over your enemies.
With perfect hatred I have hated them, and they have become enemies to me.
Test me, O Lord, and know my heart; examine me and understand my paths.
See whether there is lawlessness in me, and lead me in the everlasting ways.
Rescue me, O Lord, from the wicked man; deliver me from the false and deceitful man,
who have plotted lawlessness in their heart; every day they prepared themselves [?] for battle.
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent's, and the venom of asps is on their lips.
Keep me, O Lord, from the hand of the sinner, and deliver me from the wicked man, who have plotted to trip up my steps;
and the proud have laid [?] a snare for me; they have prepared a rope as a snare for my feet, and beside my paths they have set a trap [?] for me.
I said to the Lord: You are my God; hear, O Lord, the voice of my prayer.
O Lord, Lord, power of my life, be a protector of my head in the day of battle.
Do not give me over to the desire of sinners, for they have plotted against me; do not abandon me, lest they be exalted. Let their plots not be accomplished.
As for the head of their end, let the toil of their lips cover them.
Let coals of fire fall upon them; let them be cast down, and let them not withstand poverty.
A man of the tongue shall not prosper on the earth; evil shall hunt down the false man to destroy him.
I know that the Lord will execute judgment for the poor and justice for the fallen.
But the righteous shall confess your name, and the upright shall dwell before your face.
O Lord, I have cried out to you, hear me; attend to the voice of my prayer, to my crying out to you.
Let my prayer be directed like incense before you, the lifting up of my hands as an evening sacrifice.
Set, O Lord, a guard [?] on my mouth and a strong door on my lips,
so that my heart may not turn aside to words of wickedness, to make excuses for sins with men who work lawlessness; may I have no share in their counsels.
Let the righteous one teach me with mercy and reprove me; let the oil of the sinner not anoint my head, but let my prayer be according to his will.
Let their judges be set near the rock; let them hear my words, for they are sweet.
As the thickness of the soil is spread out upon the land, so let their bones be scattered in hell.
For to you, O Lord, Lord, my eyes are turned; in you I trust, do not take away my soul.
Keep me from the snare that they have laid for me and from the stumbling blocks of those who work lawlessness.
Let sinners fall into their own nets; I am alone; how have I escaped?
With my voice I cried out to the Lord, with my voice I prayed to the Lord.
I will pour out my prayers before him and will tell my afflictions before him.
When my spirit was failing within me, you, the Lord, knew my places; in the way on which I was walking they laid a snare for me.
I looked to my right and observed, and there was no one who knew me; my flight has perished from me, and there was no one to seek out my soul.
I cried out to you, O Lord, and said: You are my hope, my portion in the land of the living.
Attend to my prayer, for I have been greatly humbled; deliver me from my pursuers, for they have become stronger than I.
Bring my soul out of prison, so that I may confess your name. The righteous wait for me until you repay me.
Lord, hear my prayer; incline your ear to my supplication in your truth; hear me in your righteousness;
and do not enter into judgment with your servant, for no flesh shall be justified before you.
For the enemy has persecuted my soul and has brought my life low to the ground; he has made me sit in darkness, like one long dead.
My spirit has grown despondent within me, and my heart has trembled within me.
I remembered the former days; I spoke of all your deeds, and I meditated on the created works of your hands.
I stretched out my hands to you, and my soul within me is like a thirsty land.
Hear me quickly, Lord, for my spirit has failed; do not turn your face away from me, lest I become like those who go down into the pit.
Let me hear your mercy at dawn, for I trust in you; make known to me, Lord, the ways in which I should walk, for to you I have lifted up my soul.
Deliver me from my enemies, God, for I have made you my refuge.
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God; let your good Spirit lead me in an upright land.
By your name, Lord, save me in your righteousness, and bring my soul out of affliction;
by your mercy destroy my enemies and bring to ruin all who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.
Blessed is the Lord my God, who has taught my hands the contest and my fingers battle.
My mercy and my refuge, my helper and my deliverer; my comforter, and I trust in him who has subjected the people under me.
Lord, what is man, that you should make yourself known to him, or the son of man, that you should take account of him?
Man has become like vanity, and his days pass away like shadows.
Lord, bend down the heavens and descend; touch the mountains, and they will smoke;
make your lightnings flash and terrify them; send out your arrows and scatter them.
Send forth your hand with grace; deliver me and rescue me from many waters and from the hands of the children of foreign seed,
whose mouth has spoken vanity, and whose right hand was a right hand of falsehood.
God, with a new song I will praise you, and on the ten-stringed psaltery I will sing to you,
you who have given life to kings, who redeemed David your servant from the evil sword.
Deliver me and rescue me from many waters and from the hands of the children of foreign seed, whose mouth has spoken vanity, and whose right hand was a right hand of falsehood.
Their sons are like young plants, made strong in their youth; their daughters are beautified and adorned in the likeness of a temple; their storehouses are full and pass over from one to another;
their sheep bear many young and are multiplied in their goings out.
And their cows are fat; there is no falling of a wall, nor any going out, nor any outcry in their streets.
They have called blessed the people whose lot is thus; but blessed is the people whose God is the Lord.
I will exalt you, my God and my King, and I will bless your name forever and for ever and ever.
Every day I will bless you, and I will praise your name forever and for ever and ever.
Great is the Lord and greatly praised, and of his riches there is no end.
Generation and generations shall praise your works and recount your mighty deeds.
They shall speak of the majestic beauty of the glory of your holiness and tell of your wonders.
They shall declare the power of your terrible deeds and recount your riches.
They shall pour forth the memory of your abundant sweetness and rejoice in your righteousness.
The Lord is compassionate and merciful, long-suffering and greatly merciful.
The Lord is sweet toward all, and his mercies are over all their works.
All your works shall confess you, O Lord, and your holy ones shall bless you.
They shall declare the glory of your kingdom and tell of your power,
that the sons of men may know your might and the glory of the majestic beauty of your kingdom.
Your kingdom is a kingdom over all forever, and your dominion is in every generation and generation.
The Lord is faithful in all his words and righteous in all his works. The Lord upholds all who are falling and raises up those who have fallen.
The eyes of all hope in you, and you give them their food in due season.
You raise your hand and satisfy all with the sweetness of your will.
The Lord is righteous in all his ways; he is holy in all his works.
The Lord is near to all who call upon him, and to all who call upon him in truth.
The Lord will do the will of those who fear him; he will hear their prayers and save them.
The Lord will keep all who love him, and he will destroy all sinners.
My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord, and let all flesh bless his holy name forever and for ever and ever.
My soul praises the Lord.
I will praise the Lord in my life; I will sing to my God as long as I exist.
Do not trust in rulers, in the sons of men, with whom there is no salvation;
their spirit will go out of them, and they will return there to their earth; on that day all their plans will perish.
Blessed is the man whose helper is the God of Jacob, and whose hope is in the Lord his God,
who made heaven and earth, the sea and everything that is in it; who keeps truth forever;
he executes justice for those who suffer wrong, he gives food to the hungry.
The Lord sets free those who are bound, the Lord makes the blind wise, the Lord raises up the fallen, the Lord loves the righteous;
the Lord protects the sojourners [?], he will take up the orphan and the widow, and he will destroy the way of sinners.
Praise the Lord, for singing is good; to our God, may praise be sweet to him.
The Lord will build up Jerusalem, and he will gather the scattered ones of Israel,
he who heals those crushed in heart and binds up their wounds;
who counts the multitude of the stars and calls all of them by name.
Great is our Lord, great is his power, and of his understanding there is no number.
The Lord takes up the meek, but he brings sinners low, down to the ground.
Bless the Lord with thanksgiving and sing to him with praise,
who clothed the heavens with cloud and prepared rain for the earth, who makes grass spring up on the mountains and green plants for the service of men;
who gives food to the beasts and to the young of the raven that call upon him.
It is not that the Lord wants the strength of the horse, nor do the legs of a warrior please him;
rather, the Lord is pleased with those who fear him and those who hope in his mercies.
Praise the Lord, Jerusalem; sing to your God, Zion;
for he has strengthened the bolts of your gates and has blessed your children within you,
he who set your borders in peace and filled you with the richness of wheat.
He sends his word to the earth, and his command runs swiftly;
he lays down snow like wool and scatters mist like ashes;
he sets down ice in handfuls; before his cold, who can stand against him?
He sends his word and melts it; his wind blows and the waters flow.
He who declares his words to Jacob, his statutes and his judgments to Israel.
He has not done so for every nation, and he has not revealed his ordinances to them.
Praise the Lord from the heavens, praise him in the heights.
Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his hosts.
Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all stars and lights.
Praise him, heavens of heavens, and waters above the heavens.
Praise the name of the Lord, for he spoke and they came to be; he himself commanded and they were created.
He established them forever and forever and ever; he laid down a command, and they will not pass beyond it.
Praise the Lord from the earth, you sea monsters and all deeps;
fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy wind, which carry out his words;
mountains and all hills, fruitful trees and all firs;
beasts and all cattle, creeping things and winged birds;
kings of the earth and all peoples, rulers and all judges of the earth;
young men and virgins, old men together with children;
praise the name of the Lord. For his name alone is exalted, and his praise is in heaven and on earth.
And the Lord will exalt the horn of his people, for the singing of all his saints, the sons of Israel, a people who are near to him.
Sing to the Lord a new song; his praise is in the assembly of the saints.
Let Israel rejoice in his Maker, and you sons of Zion, sing to their King.
Praise his name with blessing; sing to him with praise and psalm.
For the Lord takes pleasure in his people, and he will exalt the meek with salvation.
The saints boast in glory; they rejoice upon their resting places.
The exaltation of God is in their mouth, and a two-edged sword is in their hands,
to take vengeance among the nations and to rebuke every people,
to bind their kings with fetters and their nobles with manacles of iron,
to execute judgment among them, as it is written; this is the glory of all his saints.
Praise God in his holiness; praise him in the firmament of his power.
Praise him for his mighty power; praise him for his great wealth.
Praise him with the sound of blessing; praise him with psalm and praise.
Praise him with joy and song; praise him with sweet words.
Praise him with a sound pleasing to hear; praise him with a sound of crying aloud.
Let every soul praise the Lord.
I was the least among my brothers and the youngest in my father's house, and I tended my father's sheep.
My hands made a song, and my fingers arranged a hymn of praise.
And who will tell this to my Lord? The Lord himself heard me.
The Lord himself sent his angel and brought me out from my father's sheep and anointed me with the oil of his anointing.
My brothers were better and more handsome, yet they did not please the Lord.
I went out to meet that foreigner, and he cursed me, calling by name upon his idols;
but I, in the name of the Lord my God, took his sword and cut off his head, and I wiped away the reproach from the sons of Israel.
